Dalzollene gives Neon her stack of work papers for the month from people who want their fortunes told, and Neon is unhappy with the amount of work she has been assigned. She calls her father to complain, and after some arguing, he agrees to buy her something in exchange, and she is appeased. Neon then uses her Nen ability to fill the papers with fortunes. Dalzollene collects them as she does this and picks up one of the fortunes that get dropped, shocked by what he sees on the paper. In another car, Basho and Kurapika talk about Neon's ability and her father's connections to the Mafia Community. Neon finishes with her fortune-telling, and Dalzollene agrees to take her shopping. Nobunaga, Feitan, Franklin, and Machi walk down the road together, talking about the upcoming Spider meeting. Franklin asks if Hisoka will be there, but Machi isn't sure if he'll show. While debating Hisoka's strengths and abilities, Franklin claims Hisoka isn't that tough, and he and Nobunaga get into a brawl. Machi and Feitan speculate about what Chrollo plans to have them steal at the auction, and Feitan is particularly interested in a dangerous game that he knows will be up for auction. Chrollo, Pakunoda, and Kortopi arrive at their hideout to see Hisoka already there. At the Hotel Beitacle, Dalzollene speaks on the phone with Light, worried over some of the fortunes he saw Neon write that contained the exact same lines as each other, especially since they all hinted at death or illness. Light tells him to send the clients their fortunes and warn them. Dalzollene, concerned with Neon's safety since she cannot predict her own future and since the auction will be a dangerous place, asks if he should still take her there, and Light instructs him to bring her home instead. In addition, he tells Dalzollene to get Neon whatever she wants and to retrieve the items from the auction himself so that Neon will not be upset about not going. At the Phantom Troupe meeting, Chrollo informs the other troupe members that he plans for them to steal everything available at the auction and that they are permitted to kill everyone else there while doing so. The next day, Gon and Killua look through a market in town, trying to find another way to make money after they both failed in their endeavors; Gon had only been able to make fifteen thousand, and Killua had made two hundred million jenny gambling only to lose it all, making Gon the winner of their bet. The boys stop at a stall selling cellphones, with Gon intending to buy one to stay in touch with Leorio and Kurapika while they're on the road. After looking for a bit, Leorio shows up at the stall with some helpful advice on cell phones, and the boys are excited to see him. Leorio negotiates with the stall merchant and gets the boys a deal on some cellphones. Leorio asks Killua and Gon if they've learned Nen and informs them that he has already learned it. Dalzollene gives Neon's bodyguards the rundown on what their next assignment is, which involves buying the items Neon desires from the auction and securing them that night since Neon won't be attending, and informs them of the potential attack that may happen at the auction. He runs through the list of items with them, and when he brings up the Scarlet Eyes, Melody notices Kurapika's heartbeat race. Ivlenkov, Baise, and Tocino get assigned to be bidders at the auction. In their hotel room, Gon, Killua, and Leorio try to find a way to earn the necessary money to bid for Greed Island at the Southernpiece Auction and look online again. While looking, Leorio gets an idea of how they can make money and takes the boys to the streets. They set up a table on the curb where anyone can pay a fee to arm wrestle Gon, and if the participant wins, they get a diamond ring that the boys purchased earlier. Many men immediately pay the fee and challenge Gon, thinking he'll be easy to beat; none of them succeed. Shizuku approaches the table and respectfully challenges Gon. Gon genuinely struggles against her, but ultimately wins, although he and Killua are left surprised at how strong she is. Back at the Hotel Beitacle, Neon freaks out when told she can't attend the auction herself. Dalzollene, who has large bumps on his head due to Neon's outburst, calls her father.

Episode 51 (2011) A × Brutal × Battlefield (ヒジョウ×ノ×センジョウ, "Hijō × No × Senjō") is the 51st episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on October 14th, 2012. Overview. "For the second time, the auction is on hold due to Phantom Troupe's infiltration, and has become a brutal battlefield." Summary. While shopping, Neon Nostrade is able to escape from her servants and bodyguards. Meanwhile, a man, who seems to give competition to Light Nostrade, named Zenji gathers assassins/hit-men, which include Silva, Zeno and Kurapika, to take care of the Phantom Troupe. After the assassins have made a decision, Zenji mocks Light Nostrade, but stops when threatened by Kurapika until Light tells him to cease. Zenji quickly leaves with his guards. Now traveling to the auction, Kurapika receives a call from Basho and Melody regarding Neon escaping from them. Light hears the news of his daughter and gets immensely worried, but Kurapika locates her using his Dowsing Chain. Light then immediately alerts the police and guards not to let his daughter enter the auction building. Neon, with the help of Chrollo, is able to get passed the security and goes inside the building where the auction is held. Light gets an update about his daughter that she has entered the auction house and gets worried about her safety. Meanwhile Chrollo chats with Neon about her Fortune Telling skill and asks her if she can foretell his fortune to which Neon agrees. When she finishes her ability, Chrollo reads the first verse of the paper and tears flow from his eyes by saying that all of the things foretold are true. It essentially says, he'll mourn for lost comrades, be injured, but will remain strong, and to find new teammates. The two then leave the restaurant. Neon explains when she was little she saw a Fortune Teller on TV who ended of being a con artist, but that didn't stop Neon from becoming one herself. Chrollo can't stop thinking about Neon's fortune to him. While walking, he tells Neon that he believes in ghosts, referring to Uvogin, and in memory of him, goes wild. He then knocks Neon out lightning quick. After knocking her out, Chrollo acts concerned and asks for help from the security. In the monitor operating room of the building, Assassin A asks an operator to rewind the scene where Neon collapses and sees Chrollo striking her. Kurapika and Light arrive at the building and go straight to Neon. Kurapika tells Light to leave the place with Basho and Melody and tells him that the auction will not be held since the place will be turned into a battlefield. Assassin A locates Chrollo who already disposed of another assassin, tells Assassin A to show himself and invites him to fight one on one. Feitan tells Phinks about the message he receives from their Boss, telling them to "go wild" while getting to the Cemetery Building where the auction is supposed to be held. Phinks asks him about the others and Feitan replies that they are on their way to the cemetery, but they are cleaning up trash while approaching the Building. Other members of the Troupe, except Hisoka who watches from afar, are seen in the streets of Yorknew City disposing all the police and mafia members. Meanwhile, Chrollo uses his Nen ability, Indoor Fish, on Assassin A, which has torn his body to pieces, but kept him alive. Chrollo opens the window and Assassin A is instantly killed, per the rule of the ability. Chrollo, while stating the prophecy that's been foretold to him, performs a requiem by shedding blood dedicated to Uvogin.

Episode 52 (1999) Underground Auction × Annihilation × Machinegun (×全滅×マシンガン), "Angura × Zenmetsu × Mashingan") is the 52nd episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It first aired on January 13th, 2001. Overview. "Chrollo Lucilfer, the Phantom Troupe boss, gives orders to kill everyone at the underground auction. Franklin fires Nen bullets from his machine gun fingers, and Shizuku cleans up the massacre with her Nen vacuum. Melody and Kurapika talk openly to each other on a roof. The Mafia sends the Shadow Beasts to deal with Phantom Troupe." Synopsis. Leorio, Killua, and Gon take a break from trying to earn money for the Yorknew City auction. While eating, the boys talk about how much money they've made thus far, and Killua realizes they won't have nearly enough time left to make the money they need at the rate they're going just from Gon arm-wrestling people. Still, Leorio is confident that Gon can do it, and they continue to take contestants. At the Hotel Beitacle, Neon is asleep after wearing herself down from her outburst. Dalzollene speaks to Light on the phone and tells him that she was really upset about not being able to participate in the auction herself, and will likely be even more upset if she misses the auction completely. Light tells him to secure the first item she wanted from the auction to tide her over, while Light makes his way to Yorknew City to meet them. Dalzollene briefly calls Melody and Kurapika, who are on the lookout outside the ongoing auction, to check up on them. After, during a lull in Melody and Kurapika's conversation, Melody asks Kurapika about his connection to the Scarlet Eyes, since she noticed his heartbeat increase when he saw a photo of them when they were being assigned their mission. He briefly explains his background as a member of the Kurta Clan and his mission to avenge his brethren. Melody assures him that she won't tell Dalzollene about his motives or background as she does not want to be killed, as she claims Kurapika seems like the type to kill her if he absolutely had to. In return, Kurapika asks Melody about her motives for taking the job, and she explains her quest for the Sonata of Darkness and her intention to destroy it. When Kurapika tells her that the sonata sounds like an urban myth, she pulls up her sleeve to show him the damage done to her arm due to her listening to one movement of the flute solo. The sight of it briefly horrifies Kurapika, and Melody claims her friend who died from playing it looked like her arm all over his body. She also claims she looked quite different in general before hearing it. At street level, as the auction is about to begin, a car containing Shizuku, Shalnark, and Uvogin cut off a couple of cars of men outside the auction building. When the men get out to question them, the Spiders kill them. Inside, Baise, Tocino, and Ivlenkov talk amongst a crowd of wealthy, important families. Ivlenkov notices that a few of the notable people he was expecting to see haven't shown up yet, noting how strange it is since they come every year. When the auction is set to start, Feitan stands on the auction stage, initially seeming like he is there to host the event, but quickly informs the room of bidders that he is there to kill them. Franklin appears behind him and uses his Double Machine Gun ability to shoot down everyone in the room. Tocino attempts to use his own Nen ability to shield himself, Baise, and Ivlenkov, but Franklin's Nen bullets go right through his Nen people and pierce Tocino, who coughs up a large amount of blood. Tocino insists that Baise and Ivlenkov leave the building to warn the others. As they burst through the auction room doors, Ivlenkov is struck by Shizuku's Blinky and falls over dead. Baise attempts to keep running away, but Shizuku catches up to her and kills her with Blinky as well. Shizuku joins Feitan and Franklin in the auction room, and she uses Blinky to clean up all of the corpses. One man, still alive on the floor, threatens their families, who he claims will be tracked down by the Mafia Community, and Franklin shoots him until he dies. Outside, Kurapika and Melody see a bunch of armed men pull up to the auction building, so they call Dalzollene. He instructs them to head to the auction, and when there, Kurapika and Melody tell Dalzollene that it seems like everyone somehow disappeared. Dalzollene tells them to look for any clues that Tocino and Ivlenkov may have tried to leave behind, so Kurapika uses his Dowsing Chain to search the area. It leads him and Melody to a nearby planter, where Kurapika finds a piece of Baise's jewelry covered in blood. A group of Mafia Community security finds the vault completely empty at the auction vault. They put a price on the head of the leader of the group who did it, who is currently unknown to them, to the members of the Mafia Community. Kurapika is certain that the only group who could pull off a heist like this is the Phantom Troupe. Kurapika and Melody are instructed to meet with Squala, who arrives in a car to pick them up on the street. Uvogin tells Chrollo on the phone that the vault was apparently empty when they arrived, and the items had been relocated as if the robbery was expected. Uvogin suspects that there is a among their group. Still, Chrollo is adamant that there isn't, as he can't image what that person would gain from betraying them. Chrollo also thinks their arrival wasn't expected at all, but someone high up in the Mafia Community was being cautious for some reason. Despite not being able to find out where the goods were moved to, Uvogin tells Chrollo that one of the Shadow Beasts, Owl, was tasked with moving all of the items by one of the Ten Dons. Uvogin, eager to fight the Shadow Beasts, asks for permission to take them on, and Chrollo allows it.

Episode 52 (2011) Assault × And × Impact (シュウゲキ×ト×ショウゲキ, "Shūgeki × To × Shōgeki") is the 52nd episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on October 21st, 2012. Overview. "The Phantom Troupe members go wild all over the Yorknew City and kill almost all of the mafia. Meanwhile, Silva and Zeno confront Chrollo and get involved in a big fight." Summary. The Phantom Troupe continues to wreak havoc on the streets of Yorknew City. Meanwhile, Kurapika and his Boss were in the room where Neon is resting. Kurapika decides to patrol the building, but Light stops him and begs him to stay for his daughter’s safety while waiting for their rescue and the doctor to arrive. Shortly after, the doctor arrives and examines Neon's condition. Bean questions Kurapika about him staying in Neon’s room instead of doing his job by hunting down the Phantom Troupe. Afterwards, Kurapika gets permission to patrol the building. While patrolling, bosses and members of the mafia are unsatisfied with their situation. Kurapika then receives a call from Gon and Killua. The two tell Kurapika about how they were kidnapped by the Phantom Troupe, which makes Kurapika angry at them. The two still insist on helping by giving him information, but Kurapika refuses since he has another source and doesn't want them to get involved in his mission. After their conversation, the Phantom Troupe continues their rampage while getting near the auction building. The situation inside Cemetery Building is uncontrollable in which the members of the mafia start to panic and want to protect themselves by breaking the rules of the auction. Zeno and Silva appear and warn the mafia about a member of the Phantom Troupe who sneaked inside the building, making them realize how strong he is by saying he can kill them all in less than ten seconds. Kurapika, while trying to find the Troupe, gets a call from Light, who orders him to go back to Neon. Zeno and Silva finally find Chrollo's location, and after a short chat, the three make their moves and start to battle. Chrollo manages to cut Silva by using a Ben's knife, which Silva easily recognizes, and he manages to stop the poison from spreading. Zeno analyzes Chrollo's Nen abilities and manages to deduce that Chrollo's power, because it is so powerful, has an activation cost of at least four or maybe five conditions which Chrollo is very unlikely able to meet while fighting both Zeno and Silva at the same time citing that Chrollo's use of a toxic knife is further evidence that Chrollo cannot steal Nen abilities freely; this prompts Chrollo, realizing Zeno's skill based upon his analysis of his power, to discard the knife and switch tactics. Zeno walks towards Chrollo and makes his move, but he suddenly stops. He sees Chrollo taking action using his ability, a book containing the lists of abilities he stole. Zeno becomes more cautious, uses his Nen to fight Chrollo at a distance, and manages to guess the use of Chrollo’s book while fighting. Chrollo keeps evading Zeno's attacks while not letting his guard down on Silva. When Chrollo finally feels the presence of Silva, he gets distracted and then caught in Zeno’s technique. When Chrollo is finally trapped, Zeno signals Silva to finish him off, and Silva releases two large illuminating balls of aura aimed directly toward Chrollo and his father.

Episode 53 (1999) Phantom Troupe × The Shadow Beasts × Community (旅団×陰獣×コミュニティ, "Ryodan × Injū × Komyuniti") is the 53rd episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It aired on January 20th, 2001. Overview. "The Mafia attacks the Phantom Troupe, but Uvogin single-handedly defeats them. Kurapika, Melody, and the others watch the fight from afar. The Shadow Beasts arrive, who seem strong, but even they are defeated by Uvogin as well." Synopsis. A couple of Mafiosi were in a building spot and reported that the Phantom Troupe were riding in a hot air balloon heading toward the Gordeau Desert. Kurapika, riding in a car along with Basho and Squala, learns about the Phantom Troupe's location and destination. At that same time, high-ranking mafiosi, Bean, learned about the Phantom Troupe's whereabouts and ordered their hot air balloon to be pursued and shot down. Talking to a couple of colleagues, Bean forewarns that the thieves aren't ordinary and must be immediately dealt with to avoid future conflict. He also states that the Ten Dons have dispatched the Shadow Beasts. Someplace in the Gordeau Desert, a large gathering of members of the Mafia Community surrounded the area where the Phantom Troupe's hot air balloon had crashed. As they threaten them to come down and face the consequences of their actions, the Phantom Troupe members watch them, and Nobunaga comments on how cliche they're acting. Shalnark concurs with Nobunaga, and Shizuku asks Feitan if she'll have to clean up after they're finished there. Feitan answers no, stating they've completed their work for the night. Uvogin volunteers himself to handle the mafia community as Shalnark then proposes they all play a game of cards to pass the time. On the ground, Uvogin is confronted by a pistol-wielding mafioso who points his gun at Uvogin and demands to know if they're responsible for abducting the guests. Uvogin confirms it with a smirk, and the mafiosi then asks who their leader is, but Uvogin grins and gets shot in the face. However, Uvogin catches the fired bullet in his mouth and kills the mafiosi by breaking his neck with a single smack. Uvogin then proceeds to massacre the mafiosi as Nobunaga observes and comments on Uvogin's philosophy of being strong. Franklin, who played cards with Shalnark, Shizuku, and Machi, notes how it's like a gorilla vs ants. Soon, reinforcements arrive, which Franklin notes as more people are lining up to be slaughtered. Kurapika's group then arrives, and Squala curses how the barricade of cars was blocking the way, and they'll need to help. However, Kurapika stops him and notes that something isn't right. Uvogin laments that the Mafia Community members who were sent after him weren't enough to warm him up for the upcoming Shadow Beasts. Two snipers fire at him from afar, but Uvon was impervious to the bullets, and he then tosses two stones at the snipers, which kill them on impact. A bazooka-wielding mafiosi then threatens Uvogin with his weapon that he claims could decimate a tank. On the other hand, Uvogin raises his hand against it and notes how pitiful that the mafiosi compared him to a mere tank. The mafiosi fires off the bazooka and hits Uvogin, leading the mafia community members to believe Uvogin was dead on impact. However, as the smoke clears, Uvogin is revealed to have survived the impact and proceeds to deal with the remaining members. Squala, with Basho, Melody, and Kurapika, watches the scene unfold by a telescope and Kurapika also observes it using binoculars. He claims that Uvogin stopped the bazooka strike with his hand and is likely a Enhancer Nen user with incredible strength. Basho uses Kurapika's binoculars and listens to Kurapika's commentary on Uvogin's strength. A terrified Squala proclaims there's no way they can capture Uvogin, and Basho concurs. Though Kurapika insists they continue their mission, but Squala argues against it, and at that moment, Melody hears the heartbeat of someone other than them. Immediately, the Shadow Beast named Worm tunnels up from below, and Squala claims Worm was one of the Shadow Beasts. Worm asks what family they belong to, and Squala answers the Nostrade Family, who are part of the Ritz Family. After judging the Nostrade Family's Nen capability, he advises them to stay back and let him handle the situation. Just then, three more Shadow Beasts arrive, Porcupine, Rabid Dog, and Leech comment that Uvogin is similar to how they act and would better handle him. As another the card game ends between Shalnark, Shizuku, Machi, and Franklin, Feitan alerts them that the Shadow Beasts have arrived, and three of them confront Uvogin. Upon seeing the three Shadow Beasts, Uvogin demands to know where the Underground Auction items are, but Rabid Dog asks where the guests and security are. Uvogin quickly answered that his group killed them and reasked where the auction items were. From behind, Worm tunnels up from underground and sucker punches Uvogin; however, he was astonished not only to see that his punch barely affected Uvogin, but also broke his hand. Uvogin retaliates by punching Worm in the face, and Worm counters by yanking Uvogin's arm underground with him and gives him two choices: die by him or his comrades. Despite being disadvantaged, Uvogin confidently proclaims he's not on the ropes; they all are. Charging up his free hand, Uvogin punches the ground with his Nen Ability Big Bang Impact, creating a giant crater below him. Once the smoke clears up, Uvogin's Spider Tattoo could be seen. The sight of the tattoo caused Kurapika to lose his composure gradually. Continuing their observation from their safe high distance, the Phantom Troupe members comment on how simple, yet devastating power behind Uvogin's Big Bang Impact. Nobunaga states that as simple as Uvogin's attack may be, its devastating power is an example of someone who's mastered his Nen capability to its maximum. However, Nobunaga walks back on that comment, citing it's Uvogin's dream to build up his Big Bang Impact to match the power of a nuclear warhead. Shalnark comments that Uvogin always says that and wonders if he's serious about that claim, which Nobunaga claims that Uvogin is. He goes on to state that Enhancers have enough confidence to pull it off. Switching over to Uvogin, he calls out to the final three Shadow Beasts, demanding to know who's next. The Shadow Beasts note how cocky Uvogin was and powered up with their Nen; they charge at Uvogin. Amused by the Shadow Beast's wild nature, Uvogin punches Porcupine, who punctures and entraps Uvogin in his Manipulated Hair. Sequentially, Rabid Dog tears off a piece of Uvogin's left shoulder, and Shalnark offers to help, but Uvogin dismisses the proposal. Uvogin tried to shake Porcupine off of his arm; however, Porcupine claimed that a thousand needles were embedded into him and wouldn't be able to shake him off. Hence, Uvogin tries to use Porcupine against Leech, but Porcupine softens the hairs of his that came in contact with Leech. While Uvogin continues trying to get rid of Porcupine, Rabid Dog bites off another piece of Uvogin, and moments later, he succumbs to the neurotoxins from Rabid Dog's fangs. Now paralyzed from the neck down, Leech takes advantage of Uvogin's predicament by injecting him with a special breed of leeches. Said leeches would burrow into his bladder, lay their eggs there, and the infected person would die of extreme pain when the eggs hatch. Instantly, Uvogin bites, chews, and swallows a piece of Leech's face off and laments his thought that ugly people tasted good. After swallowing, Uvogin claims that he doesn't need much to beat the remaining two Shadow Beasts. Uvogin spits out a piece of Leech's skull at Rabid Dog, who tries to block it with his hand, but it pierces through it and kills him upon impact on his face. Turning his attention to Porcupine, Uvogin lets out a loud scream that kills Porcupine and releases him from his grip on him. Stopping his observation on Uvogin, Kurapika tries to confront Uvogin, but was stopped by his comrades, and Squala tries to reason with him as he is on the phone with Dalzollene. Amid the back and forth between Squala and Kurapika, Melody notes the intense sounds of hatred originating from Kurapika's heart. So, to calm down everyone and alleviate their anxiety, Melody performs her Nen Ability, A Field in Spring. When finished, Melody suggests that they form a plan before they act. Although Kurapika's head was now calm and clear, he still insisted that he go forward and capture Uvogin. On Uvogin's side, he's chastised by Franklin and Nobunaga for not warning them about his screaming. Uvogin gives a half-hearted apology and asks Shizuku to suck the poison and leeches out of his body. However, Shizuku claims she could only suck out the poison, not the leeches with Blinky because it can't suck up any living things. Shalnark goes down to investigate the situation with the Uvogin's leech problem, recognizes them as Spotted Leeches, and explains their history and how to pass the eggs safely. Before Shizuku could suck out the poison in Uvogin's body, Kurapika used his Chain Jail to capture Uvogin and pull him to him. Unbeknownst to the group, Machi used one of her Nen Threads on Uvogin to track him.

Episode 53 (2011) Fake × And × Psyche (フェイク×デ×サイク, "Feiku × De × Saiku") is the 53rd episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on October 28th, 2012. Overview. "After Illumi murders the Ten Dons, Silva and Zeno decide to abandon their job. Later, Kurapika is devastated after hearing that the Phantom Troupe has been killed." Summary. Illumi and Kalluto arrive to assassinate the Ten Dons. Back in the Cemetery Building, the guests of the auction feel the huge explosion caused by Silva's attack on the basement. As the guests panic, Bean arrives and tells them that the Ten Dons will speak to them directly. The guests praise Neon's fortune-telling ability as they remained safe during the whole event. In the auction hall, the leader of the Ten Dons appears on a screen and apologizes for the inconvenience. He informs everyone that the leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead and the rest will soon be dealt with. Elsewhere, the Ten Dons are revealed to have been killed by Illumi. He calls Silva through their transmitter and asks his father whether his client, Chrollo Lucilfer, is still alive. From the debris inside the basement, Zeno and Chrollo emerge with little damage. Illumi tells Silva to relay a message to Chrollo: to write the payment to Illumi's account. Zeno turns to leave and when Chrollo asks why, Zeno explains that the Ten Dons were their clients and now that they are killed, Chrollo is not their target anymore. The Zoldyck Family does not kill for pleasure, everything runs because of business. Chrollo expresses his relief and asks again if they continued their fight, who would win? Zeno confidently answers himself, but if Chrollo is really decided on killing him, then that would be another matter. Zeno and Silva then turn to leave, with the latter glaring at Chrollo. When Zeno and Silva have left, Chrollo collapses on the floor and is disappointed for not being able to steal their abilities. Kurapika instructs Melody to wait at the hospital and they will send Neon there since their current location is dangerous. The doctor assures everyone that she has just fainted and but also mentions that she will be safer in the hospital. The Spiders arrive at the floor Chrollo is on after his fight with the Zoldycks. He tells Kortopi to proceed with their plan: to make static copies of their "corpses". He also orders them not to hinder the ambulance that Neon is in. While on their way to the ambulance waiting outside, Kurapika assures Light that Neon will be safe and that the ambulance will not be targeted. Bean watches from backstage as the auction begins, relieved that everything went well. He pulls out a cigarette and is offered a light by Hisoka, but is silently killed soon after by Machi. Pakunoda brings out the Solid-Gold Execution Sword, and it's revealed that Shalnark is manipulating the auction host with his Black Voice ability. As the next item, the Celadon Porcelain Vase, is introduced, the Troupe members find the original item and Kortopi uses his Gallery Fake ability to make a copy. Pakunoda brings out the fake item, and the auction proceeds without anyone suspecting a thing. As Kurapika watches the ambulance leaving, he is approached by two men and they ask him why is he not attending the auction. Kurapika is informed that the leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead. Zenji taunts Kurapika over this and ends up getting punched. Kurapika refuses to believe it unless he has seen the body with his own eyes. Chrollo's "corpse" is found outside by the Mafia, and comments on how young he is. They found the bodies of the other five members. Kurapika rushes back inside the building and arrives just in time to see the Scarlet Eyes being auctioned. He calls Light and asks if he should bid on them. Light orders that Kurapika must win the Scarlet Eyes. He bids 350 million for the eyes, but Zenji contradicts him once more, bidding 1 billion . In the end, the Scarlet Eyes cost 2.9 billion . After collecting the Scarlet Eyes, Kurapika removes his contact lenses at a restroom. He gloomily walks back towards the hospital and encounters Zenji on the road. When he's ignored by Kurapika, the Mafia boss becomes irritated and points a gun at him, threatening to kill him. In turn, Kurapika orders Zenji to step aside and also threatens him while revealing his own Scarlet Eyes. Zenji recoils in surprise and is frozen with fear as Kurapika walks past him. Gon and Killua find out Leorio and Zepile having fun in their room. Leorio invites them to drink and Killua refuses, saying that he and Gon are still underage. They narrate on how they were captured by the Spiders and Leorio is impressed that they escaped. Gon tells Zepile on how his lesson helped them during their capture. Leorio invites Gon and Killua to the auction tomorrow but Gon tells him that they will learn Nen from Kurapika. Leorio questions this as they all learned Nen at around the same time, but Gon informs him that Kurapika has already taken down a member of the Troupe on his own. Killua adds that there must be some secret to Nen which allows them to obtain power without experience. Neon awakens and is overjoyed at the sight of the Scarlet Eyes. She thanks her father and remarks on how beautiful the Scarlet Eyes are. Melody senses Kurapika's sadness and assures him. He calls Gon and informs him about the Spiders' deaths. Meanwhile, Hisoka attempts to call Kurapika but the other line is not answering. He watches as the members of the Troupe drink over the success of their mission.

Episode 54 (1999) Hisoka × Alliance × Spider Hunting (ヒソカ×同盟×クモ退治, "Hisoka × Doumei × Kumo Taiji") is the 54th episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It first aired on January 27th, 2001. Overview. "Kurapika captures Uvogin with his chains and runs away. Uvogin is left with Dalzollene and the others as Kurapika meets with Hisoka, who promised to give information on the Phantom Troupe. Dalzollene tells the Mafia to get Uvogin, but Phantom Troupe members arrive, killing him and freeing Uvogin. Leorio shows Gon and Killua his Ten, which is the only Nen technique he knows." Synopsis. At the Phantom Troupe's hideout, Hisoka tells Chrollo he needs to meet someone in the city and asks for his permission to leave. Chrollo allows it, and Hisoka leaves. Kurapika, in a car with Basho, Melody, Squala, and a tied up Uvogin, informs Dalzollene over the phone that he has captured a member of the Phantom Troupe. Uvogin insists that Kurapika's chains won't be able to hold him and that Kurapika should kill him before it's too late. Uvogin is immediately surprised by Kurapika's power, as Kurapika constricts the chains around Uvogin's body so tightly to the point that Uvogin passes out. Elsewhere, Machi informs her fellow Spiders that she will be able to follow Uvogin and the people who captured him using a Nen thread she attached to Uvogin's body. Melody informs the others in the car with her that another group is tailing them as another car appears in the distance behind them. The others in the car manage to find the needle and thread that Machi attached to Uvogin and quickly remove it from his body. However, by this time, the car behind them containing some of the Spiders had already caught up to them. Right as the Spiders' car closes in, Owl jumps onto the car and uses his Fun Fun Cloth to shrink the Spiders' car down, and Kurapika's crew loses sight of it as they drive away. Off the road, Owl talks to most of the Spiders who had been in the car impressed that they could escape before he shrunk the car down. He picks up the tiny Fun Fun Cloth with the car and Nobunaga, who could not make it out in time, in it. Several of the other Shadow Beasts appear to back Owl up. When Uvogin comes to, he is tied down in the basement of one of the hotels where the Nostrade Family is staying, with the Nostrade bodyguards surrounding him. Dalzollene uses his sword to threaten Uvogin for information, but Uvogin remains unfazed. Dalzollene channels his aura through his sword and stabs right into Uvogin's shoulder wound left by Rabid Dog. However, Uvogin lies calmly while this happens, as Dalzollene's sword can barely puncture him at all. Instead, Uvogin agrees to give them the information they want, but warns them that they should let him go if they don't want to be killed. He tells them that the Spiders never got the chance to steal the goods from the auction, and the group is shocked to hear this. Kurapika confronts Uvogin about the deaths of their colleagues at the auction and is unhappy with Uvogin's carefree response. Kurapika then punches Uvogin in the face, using his hand holding Baise's bracelet, and leaves Uvogin with a bloody nose. Dalzollene instructs the other bodyguards to depart, and they leave Uvogin tied down in the room for the other members of the Mafia Community to deal with. Dalzollene speaks with one of the other Mafia Community members on the phone about Uvogin and is in turn informed about the death of all the Shadow Beasts. In their hotel room, Leorio tries to show off his aura to Killua and Gon, who inform him that he is actually using Ten. Leorio gives up for now and heads out for the night, leaving the other two boys alone in the hotel room. Leorio hopes to see Kurapika while he is out, but never does. At the hotel, Kurapika receives a text on his phone from Hisoka, confirming their rendezvous for that night. Kurapika asks Dalzollene if he can leave his post for two hours, which Dalzollene allows. Dalzollene also allows the other bodyguards to go on break and takes over watching Uvogin. At an abandoned building, Kurapika meets up with Hisoka. Kurapika asks Hisoka for information on the Phantom Troupe, which Hisoka provides. He also informs Kurapika that he is interested in taking down the leader of the Spiders and proposes an alliance to Kurapika, even offering to tell him seven of the Spiders' abilities if he agrees. Back at the hotel, Dalzollene lets a group of Mafia Community members into the basement to retrieve Uvogin. Dalzollene is promptly killed by one of them, and they are revealed to be Shalnark, Shizuku, Phinks, Nobunaga, and Machi. When they release Uvogin and remove the nerve gas and poison from his body, he immediately lets out his rage, swearing vengeance on the people who put him there. Elsewhere, Melody receives a notification on her phone. Dalzollene, not actually dead yet, takes on the Spiders in his last few moments to buy the other bodyguards some additional time to get there. Kurapika, who is still negotiating with Hisoka, gets a call from Melody informing him what has happened to Dalzollene and Uvogin. Before Kurapika can leave, Hisoka proposes a give-and-take relationship with Kurapika. Kurapika tells Hisoka to meet him there again the following night and leaves. As the other Spiders are making their escape from the hotel, Uvogin says he needs to stay to settle his score with Kurapika.

Episode 54 (2011) Fortunes × Aren't × Right? (ウラナイ×ガ×アタラナイ？, "Uranai × Ga × Ataranai") is the 54th episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on November 4th, 2012. Overview. "Gon, Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio finally reunite. Chrollo writes the Troupe's fortunes. Hisoka informs Kurapika that the Troupe's corpses were fake." Summary. Gon, Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio finally reunite in Yorknew City and have some words with each other. Kurapika explains his Nen powers to his friends and the sacrifices he's made to become stronger. Killua gets angry because he believes that a member from the Phantom Troupe who can read memories is still alive. Kurapika also mentions teaming up with Hisoka who gave him some information about the Troupe. Meanwhile, Chrollo orders the Troupe to depart Yorknew by night. Nobunaga denies, stating that they need to find the chain user and avenge Uvogin's death. After Franklin advises him to follow their Boss' orders, he starts questioning if it was indeed an order from their Boss. He calls Chrollo by his name and wants to ask him a few questions. Chrollo faces him, stating that before he answers his questions, he needs to first, answer his questions. Chrollo asks Nobunaga about his date of birth, blood type, and even his full name and gives him a sheet of paper to write down his answers. He then uses the technique he stole from Neon Nostrade to foretell Nobunaga's future. Nobunaga's fortune states that the Phantom Troupe will lose more members. The passage is similar to Chrollo's own fortune. Shizuku asks Chrollo to foretell her fortune too. She deciphers the verses with the help of Chrollo and learns that she is one of the members who will die by next week along with Shalnark and Pakunoda. After learning the results, the members remind Nobunaga that they might get killed if they keep on pursuing the chain user. Chrollo also reminds him about his position and value on the Troupe. Hisoka jumps into the conversation and asks Chrollo if he can foretell the fortunes of each member. Meanwhile, Kurapika still plans to collect the eyes of his clan, when suddenly he receives a message from Hisoka stating that the corpses were fake. He becomes distressed and is furious with himself for not thinking of the possibility of fake corpses sooner. The situation has changed and Gon, Killua, and Leorio offer their help and support. Kurapika then receives a call from Melody and she says that the mafia has given up hunting the Phantom Troupe. It was a direct order from the Ten Dons. The reward has been rescinded as they learned the Troupe originates from Meteor City and they wish to preserve their relationship with the city. The members of the Phantom Troupe have their fortunes told by Chrollo. Hisoka's fortune is shown to be about meeting and teaming up with Kurapika and giving him information about some of the Phantom Troupe members' abilities. It also foreshadows when he will face Chrollo alone. Pakunoda wants to see Hisoka's fortune, but Hisoka warns her she might regret it. On handing his fortune to her, it somehow changes. After learning Hisoka's fortune, Pakunoda immediately shows it to the others. Nobunaga is furious after reading Hisoka's fortune, questioning him if he sold out Uvogin. Trivia. The exchange between Chrollo and Nobunaga in this episode is the only instance in the 2011 anime adaptation of any Phantom Troupe member (except Hisoka) addressing the leader by name.

Episode 55 (1999) Uvo × Kurapika × Melody of Determination (ウボォー×クラピカ×覚悟の旋律, "Ubō × Kurapika × Kakugo no Senritsu") is the 55th episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It first aired on February 3rd, 2001. Overview. "Kurapika contacts Light Nostrade and is put in charge after Dalzollene's death. Uvogin finds Kurapika alone with Neon with the others in another room. They decide to fight outside the city. Gon's arm wrestling becomes popular, and they are invited to an underground betting ring. Everyone is given pictures of the Phantom Troupe with a bounty of 2 billion for each head." Synopsis. Uvogin steps out of the hotel he was being held in, determined to find Kurapika and settle the score with him. The other Spiders who came to free Uvogin, particularly Shalnark, run after him and try to convince him that he shouldn't go off alone. Nobunaga leaves it up to a coin toss. Uvogin chooses heads and wins, so he goes on his own to find Kurapika, promising to return for the Phantom Troupe meeting the next day; Shalnark goes with him as his driver. At the Hotel Beitacle, Melody tries to contact Dalzollene, who won't pick up her calls; Squala assumes him to be dead. The bodyguards deliberate over what to do next since Dalzollene is the only one who can contact their boss, Light. Kurapika suggests that they check in with Neon instead. Although some of the other bodyguards aren't happy with the idea, they do so with little other option. The bodyguards go to Neon's room, and Kurapika wakes her. They explain the situation to her regarding the auction and the deaths of their coworkers. Aside from Kurapika, the group is shocked when Neon's response shows that she is only worried about the safety of her money and potentially getting the auction items she wanted later on. Kurapika reassures Neon that her money and items are safe, and Neon is relieved. Kurapika asks her what they should do now, and Neon suggests they call her dad. She hands him her phone, and the group argues over who should make the call and likely get appointed as the group leader in the process, with seemingly none of them wanting to do it. Melody suggests that they vote on it, and the group unanimously votes for Kurapika. Kurapika accepts and gets Neon to call her dad and introduce him. She does so, explaining the circumstances to her father, before handing the phone over to Kurapika. Kurapika steps out into the hall to speak to Light, intending to try to sway the situation in his own favor. During their conversation, Kurapika convinces Light that Neon isn't safe in Yorknew City, and Light agrees to get her himself. He also officially puts Kurapika in charge for the time being. Kurapika returns and gets Squala to stay and watch over Neon, much to Squala's displeasure. Elsewhere, Uvogin and Shalnark break into a building and subdue the man there to use the computer to access the Hunter Website to get information about the place where Uvogin was being held captive. Shalnark can locate the three other hotels in the city where the Nostrade Family is staying and prints out a map of them for Uvogin. Uvogin kisses Shalnark as thanks and runs off to go search the hotels to find Kurapika. At the Hotel Beitacle, Kurapika speaks to the front desk over the phone while using the computer for his own research. Later, he gathers the other bodyguards and shows them the Hunter Website and how easy it would be for someone to figure out where they were staying. Anticipating that at least one of the Spiders will come looking for them or Neon, Kurapika instructs Squala to move Neon to a different room and for the other bodyguards not to leave the new room either. Kurapika informs them that he will be staying behind, and although Melody is very worried for Kurapika, she leaves with the other bodyguards. On her way out, Kurapika mouths a comforting message to her. At Killua, Gon, and Leorio's room hotel, the three boys try to come up with a new way for them to make money they will need to bid on Greed Island, as they are nowhere near close to the amount they will need. Leorio says he has a new plan, taking them back to the same spot in the city where Gon arm wrestled before. The crowd mostly consists of the same people who already challenged Gon before and lost, and no one is interested in participating. Leorio reveals to the two boys that he intended for this to happen to lure out more difficult opponents who may have heard of Gon's strength by now and may be willing to offer up more money. A larger challenger soon approaches, having heard about Gon's strength, but right before the match starts, Leorio says he wants to switch places with Gon and puts up more money to do so. Leorio easily wins, and the man accompanying the challenger gives Leorio a business card. At one of the other Nostrade hotels, Uvogin interrogates a man connected to the family, who immediately caves, assuming that Uvogin may spare his life if he talks. He easily gives up much information about the Nostrade family, particularly about Neon and her ability; Uvogin kills the man anyway. Leorio, Killua, and Gon show up at an underground auction in the city, following the information Leorio got from the business card. They show up, expecting it to be a high-value auction, although they are unsure of what kind. They are led to a large crowd surrounding a wrestling ring in the back. The announcer explains the game of hide and seek that everyone will be participating in, and everyone is handed a paper with seven people for them to target and capture. All seven of them are members of the Phantom Troupe, and Gon and Killua instantly recognize Shizuku. The prize for each target is two billion, which immediately entices the boys into participating. Later that evening, Killua and Leorio sit on a bench in the city, seemingly uninterested in searching for the seven targets. When Gon confronts them about it, Killua and Leorio explain the strange circumstances and set up of the so-called "auction" to Gon. They can infer that the game of "hide and seek" was likely not what the original event was supposed to be and that the Mafia Community is probably desperately looking for these targets. Additionally, although they do not know the people on the list, they can deduce that they are most likely members of the Phantom Troupe. Gon attempts to call Kurapika to tell him about the photos. At the Hotel Beitacle, Kurapika's cell rings, but he doesn't answer it. Instead, he watches the elevator before him, anticipating someone's arrival. The elevator reaches Kurapika's floor, and Uvogin steps out. Uvogin allows Kurapika to choose the place where the two of them will fight, and they leave the hotel.

Episode 55 (2011) Allies × And × Lies (ナカマ×ト×イカサマ, "Nakama × To × Ikasama") is the 55th episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on November 11th, 2012. Overview. "The Phantom Troupe discusses Hisoka's fortune and decides to stay in Yorknew City. Kurapika reveals his Nen abilities to Gon. Killua returns to the Phantom Troupe's base, to find out it multiplied by 50." Summary. After reading Hisoka's fortune, Nobunaga accuses him of selling out the Phantom Troupe to the Chain User. With sword drawn, Nobunaga gets no answer from Hisoka, who sits calmly fiddling with his cards. Shalnark and Franklin try to settle him down, knowing the fortunes can be avoided. Hisoka tells them that the first verse with the Chain User is true, but after that, he can't explain the rest. He'll fight, but only to defend himself. Nobunaga decides to attack but is teleported to higher ground, away from Hisoka, by Chrollo. He himself asks Hisoka a few questions about the fortune, but Hisoka does not say a word about his relationship with Kurapika. He analyzes the fortune further, asking which powers Hisoka has seen from the various Troupe members and deduces the Chain User's abilities. One is to capture and kill, as he did with Uvogin, and another being to control what one says, this coming from the line, "Sword of Law" in Hisoka's fortune. Chrollo believes this "sword" is pointed towards Hisoka's heart, restricting his speech. Hisoka naturally becomes aroused at Chrollo's reasoning skills, wanting to kill him all the more. Shalnark reviews, wondering if the Chain User is a Manipulator or a Conjurer. It is important since a Conjurer can walk around unarmed, so they might never see someone with actual chains. They figure Hisoka will not be able to fight the Chain User because of this. In his mind, Hisoka laughs at them, having fabricated most of his fortune using his Nen. There's no "Sword of Law" at his heart and he only revealed Uvogin and Shizuku's powers. If Chrollo hadn't fallen for the ruse, Hisoka knows he'd be in trouble, but now might have an opportunity to fight Chrollo. Shizuku reads the second verse, with Phinks confused at one of the lines. Shalnark believes more than half of the Troupe will be dead if they return home. Phinks says he, Feitan, and Kortopi are also in danger since they didn't have their fortunes taken. Chrollo's decision is to stay in Yorknew City. Meanwhile, Killua decides not to pursue the Troupe with Gon. Killua believes the risk is too much, now without even a reward for their capture, but Gon still thinks it's the right thing to do. Killua reminds him they're there for Greed Island and still need funds for it. Gon has a plan but keeps it a secret, much to Killua's annoyance, so they can continue stalking the Troupe. Killua agrees but knows they need Kurapika's help. At the hotel, Neon Nostrade leaves to go shopping with Basho and Melody accompanying while Squala stays in the room. Leorio and Kurapika meet to discuss the upcoming auction. Leorio thinks Kurapika should tell the Mafia that the Troupe is still alive, but he tells Leorio it won't make a difference. He just hopes the auction will take place so he can attack the Troupe once again, which Leorio thinks is crazy without help. Gon and Killua enter, telling him they'll help and Kurapika accepts, surprising Killua. The four sit around, coming up with a plan. Killua will stake out the Troupe base and Kurapika makes it clear their target will be Pakunoda. Leorio will be the driver for Kurapika and Gon will act as a decoy so Pakunoda can be snatched away. Gon will have to stall them for one second and thinks back to how fast they all are. To increase his resolve, like Kurapika's, Gon asks for him to put a Nen blade next to his heart. All three are stunned, but Leorio and Killua leave so he can explain to Gon his powers, which will put him in even more danger with others knowing his secrets. Kurapika conjures his chains and explains the first is Chain Jail, to encompass a Troupe member completely with unbreakable chains that force the person into a Zetsu state. Another is Judgment Chain, the attack that points a blade towards the heart with rules involved. Only Chain Jail is for the Troupe members, but Judgment Chain can be used on anyone, however, he must be in his Scarlet Eyes phase. Gon is shocked to see Kurapika can turn on his Scarlet Eyes whenever he wants now. The eyes make him a Specialist, which makes his attacks stronger and increases his essence and resolve. Gon is confused about the premise but wants the Nen blade nonetheless. Kurapika accepts, but not before Killua and Leorio pop up from behind him and ask if he can one for all of them. The blades can be taken away after the mission is complete, but Kurapika never had any intention to use the blades on his friends at all. Gon asks why Kurapika revealed such important details about his ability when it only increases his risk. Kurapika answers that he wanted to thank the three of them for their resolve, adding that even if his secret were to leak from any of them, he would have no regrets. Kurapika is glad that he has such good friends and expresses his gratitude. Gon smiles, but mentions how unfair Kurapika is being since he believes the pressure of letting down a friend is much worse than risking his life. Kurapika says that was his goal and the two laugh. Killua dismisses himself and heads out to the Troupe base so their plan can begin. Various Troupe members go over their fortunes again, many with unpleasant predictions. Chrollo puts them into groups: Shizuku, Machi, and Pakunoda; Kortopi, Feitan, and Phinks; Chrollo, Shalnark, and Nobunaga; Bonolenov, Franklin, and Hisoka. Machi mentions Gon and Killua to Chrollo, reminding Nobunaga he wanted them recruited into the Troupe. Machi tells Chrollo she thinks they have something to do with the Chain User, so just as a precaution, Kortopi creates multiple fake bases to throw them off. Killua arrives to find fifty new identical buildings! Trivia. The two examples Chrollo mentions for Sword of Law conditions (“Don’t lie to me” and “Do not reveal anything about me”) when discussing Hisoka’s fake fortune mirror the conditions Kurapika actually used on Uvogin in Episode 47 (requiring him to truthfully answer all of his questions) and would later use on Pakunoda in Episode 58 (forbidding her from revealing anything about him to the rest of the Phantom Troupe).

Episode 56 (1999) Scarlet Eyes × Duel × Cost of Life (緋の眼×決闘×命の代償, "Hi no Me × Kettō × Inochi no Daishō") is the 56th episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It first aired on February 10th, 2001. Overview. "Killua's father was once paid to kill a Phantom Troupe member: he succeeded, but said it was hard and advised his sons to stay away from them. Gon, Killua, and Leorio search with no results. Gon gets a loan of 100 million by pawning his Hunter License. Kurapika and Uvogin fight, with Uvogin fighting at full strength, yet Kurapika has the upper hand due to a deadly oath and finally kills him." Synopsis. Killua, Gon, and Leorio worry over Kurapika's safety, as he isn't answering their phone calls. Leorio tries to assure the other two boys that Kurapika is probably faring ok on his own. Still, Killua, in particular, worries about him potentially going up against the Phantom Troupe by himself. He recalled the time his father was tasked with targeting one of the members and complained about his opponent's strength, warning his sons not to go near the Troupe. The boys also worry about how they'll possibly be able to target the members of the Phantom Troupe themselves since they need the reward money. Despite their concerns, the boys still decide to go after the Phantom Troupe members. Without being able to afford the cost of getting info on the Spiders from the Hunter Website, the boys decide to go off on their own to see if they can scout the Spiders out. The trio splits up, but they still have no leads on the Spiders by the time night falls. Elsewhere, Uvogin and Kurapika prepare for their fight. Uvogin urinates to remove the last of the leeches from his body, while Kurapika says an oath under his breath to his fallen clan. When the two finally face each other, Uvogin asks Kurapika about his motivations for fighting him, and Kurapika tells him his intentions to get revenge for his clan. Uvogin, despite being able to recall some of the people he has killed in the past, cannot recall anything about the Kurta Clan or the Scarlet Eyes. When Kurapika questions Uvogin about how he feels when he kills people, he is enraged by Uvogin's nonchalant response, and their fight begins. Uvogin and Kurapika can both dodge each other's initial attacks, but Uvogin can quickly land a punch on Kurapika. He is shocked to see that Kurapika seems completely uninjured from his attack. He rushes towards Kurapika, but Kurapika can easily dodge him and retaliate, getting behind Uvogin and kicking his head into the rock wall behind them. Uvogin gets serious and decides to start attacking Kurapika with his full power. He lunges at Kurapika and attacks a rock wall on the other side of them, which shakes a large boulder loose. When the boulder hits the ground, the area becomes clouded in sand and haze, and Kurapika cannot find Uvogin as he conceals his aura with In. Uvogin attacks Kurapika from behind, punching him to the ground. He assumes he has broken Kurapika's back with the amount of force he used, but to his complete shock, Kurapika stands back up. Kurapika reveals that he had been using In to conceal his conjured chains wrapped around Uvogin's body. Uvogin is very confused, having assumed Kurapika to be a Manipulator. Kurapika removes one of his contacts to show his Scarlet Eyes and tells Uvogin that he is a Specialist when his eyes turn red. Uvogin, seeing the Scarlet Eyes before him, suddenly remembers seeing them previously on the Kurta Clan, remarking that Chrollo particularly liked them. In a flashback to when Izunavi was training Kurapika, Izunavi notices Kurapika's aura suddenly strengthen as his eyes turn scarlet. When Kurapika's training has been completed, and Kurapika goes to leave, Izunavi warns him a final time to let go of his grudge. He claimed that Kurapika would gain nothing from it and could not handle the burden of having blood on his hands. In the present, Uvogin struggles to try and break out of Kurapika's chains while Kurapika heals the broken bones in his own arm completely. Kurapika explains that his middle chain enforces Zetsu on the Spiders trapped in it, suppressing their aura. Kurapika closes in on Uvogin and repeatedly punches him in the abdomen with his enhanced fist. He instructs Uvogin to tell him everything he knows about the Spiders. Still, Uvogin insists that Kurapika just kill him, refusing to give up any info on his fellow Troupe members. After a while of repeated beatings, Uvogin begins coughing up blood onto them both. Kurapika stabs into Uvogin's heart with his Stake of Retribution, giving him one last chance to reveal the location of the other Spiders. Uvogin, still refusing to tell Kurapika anything, gets his heart crushed by Kurapika's chain and falls forward, dead. Immediately after the fight ends, Kurapika holds his own head, shaking violently. He digs a grave in the ground for Uvogin and buries his body. Back in the city, the boys have yet to get a single lead on the Phantom Troupe, and Leorio suggests that they post an ad online looking for info on the Troupe, hoping that by asking enough follow-up questions, they'll be able to figure out who has legitimate leads. Gon suggests that they also offer a huge reward for the information. Because the trio doesn't have enough money, Gon offers to pawn his Hunter License. At the Phantom Troupe's hideout, Shalnark worries about Uvogin. He checks in with Feitan first before going to Chrollo, who tells the Spiders that if Uvogin doesn't return to them by dawn, they'll shift their plans. Gon goes to a business to pawn his license and signs a contract in exchange for one hundred million. Although Killua and Leorio are unsure of the idea, Gon goes through with it.

Episode 56 (2011) Beloved × And × Beleaguered (サイアイ×ト×サイアク, "Saiai × To × Saiaku") is the 56th episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on November 18th, 2012. Overview. "Chrollo uses Neon to find the "Chain User", Kurapika. Meanwhile, Killua keeps an eye on the Phantom Troupe base and is joined by Melody, who discovers the Troupe is headed towards Kurapika's hotel. The Troupe finally closes in on Kurapika." Summary. Gon, Leorio, and Kurapika ride in a car on a rainy day. Kurapika, in disguise from the Phantom Troupe, talks with Killua on a cell phone. Killua is in the neighborhood of the Phantom Troupe hideout, having found out where they were after being caught. There are new buildings, making it hard for him to find where the Troupe is. The new buildings were constructed with Nen by Kortopi. Killua isn't sure what to do since the buildings are rigged and he's nervous about running into one of the Troupe members. Kurapika contacts Melody who is still shopping with Neon. Meanwhile Chrollo, Shalnark, Phinks, Franklin, Shizuku, Pakunoda, Machi, Nobunaga, Feitan, Kortopi, Bonolenov, and Hisoka discuss Kurapika, or as they call him, the "Chain User", as well as the Nostrade Family and the various bodyguards protecting Neon. They are each given flyers with pictures of each bodyguard. Chrollo realizes after meeting Neon and stealing her powers, he could have gotten information from her about Kurapika and the reason she's in Yorknew City. He pieces together that Neon likes collecting body parts, like the Scarlet Eyes at the Underground Auction, and that Kurapika is also after the eyes and revenge for his brethren. The Troupe look through the boxes that were stolen from the auction for the eyes. Kortopi uses his powers, by touching the eyes, to find the copy he created. It leads to the hotel where Neon and company are staying. Nobunaga wants to go immediately, and Chrollo tells him he's going too. On a roof, Killua stakes out the hideout the best he can, when he gets a call from Melody. He learns of Melody's amazing ability to hear. Chrollo, Nobunaga, Shizuku, Kortopi, Machi, and Pakunoda make their way towards the hotel. Melody is instantly able to hear their movements. The two follow the Troupe, as Gon calls Killua for an update. Leorio drives them to a train station the Troupe is headed to, while Melody and Killua ride on the same train. Kurapika realizes they're headed for the hotel Neon is staying at. Squala, in the hotel room, talks on the phone with Eliza who is still stuck with Neon shopping. He talks to his dogs about a better future with her. The Troupe exit the train, and Kurapika informs Squala they're headed his way. Kurapika says he must stay away from the Troupe, so they don't sense his killing intent, so Gon must give him enough time to use his chains. Squala exits the room, enters an elevator, the whole time the Troupe knowing his exact movements because of the Scarlet Eyes' copy. The Troupe rush toward the hotel, Leorio unable to follow because of traffic. Gon and Kurapika go on foot. Killua learns of this as well and follows along. The Troupe sense this and Nobunaga, Pakunoda, and Kortopi go on ahead to follow Squala; Chrollo, Machi, and Shizuku confront the three. The three hide instantly. Kurapika enraged is about to use his chains when Gon and Killua give themselves up. They tie up Gon and Killua, believing they're connected with Kurapika. Gon asks why they kill people, and Chrollo can only give confusing, rambling answers. Kurapika and Melody watch on, and Kurapika is not pleased. Melody calms him down when she tells him he's the one who got Gon and Killua caught. They mention Squala not answering his phone. Squala is frozen with fear with Nobunaga in front of his car and Pakunoda pointing a gun to his head. They know he's not the "Chain User", but know he's a bodyguard. Pakunoda breaks Squala's arm during questioning, as Squala says he had no idea Kurapika is the "Chain User". She uses her powers to find out about Eliza and Squala becomes furious, but in an instant, Nobunaga removes his head. Eliza suddenly has a strange feeling. Pakunoda uses Memory Bomb, a Nen ability to shoot thoughts in people's heads, on Nobunaga and Kortopi to give them a clear image of what Kurapika looks like. Naturally, Nobunaga gets excited, wanting his revenge.

Episode 57 (1999) Gon × Treasure × Dangerous Man (ゴン×お宝×危うい男, "Gon × Otakara × Oyaui Otoko") is the 57th episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It first aired on February 17th, 2001. Overview. "Leorio tries to help Gon buy Greed Island. They need 8.9 billion, so they go to a flea market and use Gyo to buy items with Nen. They meet Zepile, a professional seller. With money to pay for information, Leorio calls to tell them that two Phantom Troupe members are in the city." Synopsis. Gon receives the money transfer for one hundred million jenny to his account, and him, Killua, and Leorio head to purchase the Southernpiece Catalog. After buying the catalog, they search it for Greed Island before going off to find a way to earn money for the game. While walking among vendors in the Bull Market, Gon gets a strange feeling from one of the items up for auction, a Ben's knife, that a particular vendor has. He asks how much it is before being informed that it is a silent auction and needs to write down a bid for the item. Killua recognizes the knife and asks Leorio to try and haggle for it. They win the knife, and Killua explains the history of the item and its value. Gon claims he didn't know anything about the item, but after the feeling he got from looking at it, he examined it with Gyo and could see a faint aura around it. Killua also tries the same thing and sees the aura, remembering how Wing told them that people passionate about their craft would use Nen without even knowing it. They decide to use this information to view the items at different vendors with Gyo, which hopefully will be a foolproof way for them to make the money they need if they can buy low-cost items worth a lot. Leorio, unable to use Gyo, heads back to their hotel instead. Killua and Gon bid on and win three items that they saw auras around, remarking that they missed out on a vase because a man named Zepile kept outbidding them for it. They take their newly bought items to an antique dealer, who appraises two out of the three items as being quite high-value. However, the dealer appraises the last of their items, a statue, as worth less than they originally bought it for, although he says the wood box it came in is worth a bit. He offers the boys a deal for all three of the items. Still, Zepile enters the establishment and exclaims that the appraiser is lying to them about the statue's worth, claiming that it is actually a Wooden Vault and, if genuine, will contain a ton of treasure. The boys thank Zepile for his help and sit down with him at a restaurant, only to learn that he was the man who kept outbidding them previously. Zepile asks the boys how they knew the value of the items they bid on and is shocked to hear that they actually know anything about the items they were obtaining. Seeing no harm in it, Gon and Killua explain their real reasoning for choosing the items to Zephile. Outside the restaurant, Milluki walks by, having made it to Yorknew City. Zephile gets curious about why the boys need so much money, and Killua agrees to answer him if they can play a game where they each take turns asking each other one question at a time. During this game, Killua inquires as to why Zepile would want the statue he outbid them for if it's apparently worthless, and Zepile reveals that it is actually a counterfeit that he made; he claims that he felt bad about the poor craftsmanship of his counterfeits and tries to buy them back whenever he sees them somewhere. Zepile ends up offering to work for the boys as their personal appraiser, and they agree to take him on, but give him one test first, having him open the Wooden Vault for them. They head to Zepile's room, and he opens the vault for them, revealing the treasure inside. Zepile brings the boys and their wooden vault and its treasure to the Preview Market, where a crowd of people immediately takes an interest in it. However, a man from the crowd starts casting doubt on its authenticity to make the other people wary of buying it and hopefully drive down its price. Zepile goes up to argue with the man, but the man makes a solid argument about the item possibly being tampered with, which Zepile has trouble disputing. The crowd is further doubtful of the item when Zepile can't produce a certificate of authenticity for it. Gon approaches them and asks the man about other types of scams and tricks that people use, declaring himself the owner of the item and curious about ways that people might try to fool him. Many people in the crowd end up liking Gon, and afterward, Zepile states that they may have a decent chance of the item getting sold at the auction, depending. During their conversation, Leorio calls Gon and informs him that someone tipped them off about the location of two of the Spiders that they're looking for and even provided a photo of Machi and Nobunaga in the wild as proof. Gon and Killua run off, entrusting the sale of their item to Zepile.

Episode 57 (2011) Initiative × And × Law (センテ×ト×オキテ, "Sente × To × Okite") is the 57th episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on December 2nd, 2012. Overview. "Gon and Killua are held captive by the Troupe, while Kurapika, along with the others capture Chrollo as a hostage in order to capture Pakunoda." Summary. As Gon and Killua are captured by Phantom Troupe, Chrollo orders the rest of the members to meet up at Hotel Beitacle. Melody, who overhears their conversation, goes there first with Kurapika and has formed a plan. When the Troupe arrives at the said hotel, Leorio is seen sitting in the lobby. He suddenly picks up his phone and pretends to call someone. Later, it is revealed that Leorio is trying to relay a message to Gon and Killua about their plan. The boys quickly comprehend the message and do as he said. Pakunoda, Nobunaga, and Kortopi arrive there. Nobunaga is surprised in seeing the two again and thinks that they have changed their minds about joining the Troupe. He asks them to be friends with him. Killua refuses and states that he does not want to see their faces. As he turns away and closes his eyes, Gon realizes that if they do that, it won't seem suspicious for them to close their eyes to adjust it when the lights go out. Chrollo asks Pakunoda to check on them once again. She does as he says and approaches them. Since there is still one minute left, Gon and Killua have to buy time before Pakunoda can check on them. Killua starts saying that her abilities won't work since they are innocent. This, however, works perfectly as planned. Right after Pakunoda knows the truth, the lights go out and Killua breaks free from Machi's thread and breaks Pakunoda's left arm, followed by Gon kicking her chin. Machi then pulls out the thread which tied Gon's arms to prevent him from escaping. Killua tries to set Gon free by killing Machi, but his claws end up trapped within her muscles, making him unable to move and captured by Machi. Gon then tries to save his friend, but is caught by Nobunaga instead. Suddenly, a sword is thrown from the outside with a letter tied on it. As they realize that their boss is gone, Nobunaga decides to open the letter. The letter is from Kurapika, and Nobunaga gives it to Pakunoda. It says that if she talks about the boys' memories, he will kill Chrollo. She then remains silent to prevent the boss from being killed. The room suddenly goes bright again. Not long after that, Phinks, Feitan, and Shalnark come for help. When they are discussing the situation, Phinks suddenly gets a call from Kurapika. He says that he will give three demands and they must obey them, or else, the leader will be killed. Kurapika asks to talk to Pakunoda and orders her to meet up at the place he designated. He then tells Nobunaga that the rest of the members should go back to the hideout. After that, he gives directions to Pakunoda regarding the place where they will meet. Shortly after that, she goes to the said place alone. Meanwhile, at the Troupe's hideout, Hisoka is seen smiling and says that it is the perfect chance to fight Chrollo, but if he leaves, Chrollo will die. He then picks up his phone and asks Illumi for help.

Episode 58 (1999) Gon × Killua × Deadly Chase (ゴン×キルア×命がけの尾行, "Gon × Kirua × Inochi ga ke no Bikō") is the 58th episode of the original Hunter × Hunter anime. It first aired on February 24th, 2001. Overview. "Gon, Killua and Leorio arrive where Nobunaga and Machi are to spy on them. Leorio, unable to use Zetsu to hide his aura, returns home, while Gon and Killua follow them, but get captured. Light Nostrade arrives, giving orders to Neon, Kurapika and the others. The Mafia hires professional assassins, including Silva and Zeno from the Zoldyck Family." Synopsis. The Nostrade bodyguards, along with Eliza, watch over Neon while awaiting Light's arrival. Kurapika returns to the hotel, and the other bodyguards are shocked and worried over his appearance; he is haggard and bloody, with torn clothes. He goes to his room and is so exhausted that he falls to the floor. Melody, worried about him, hesitates to enter his room before deciding against it. Kurapika stays in his room, alone, saying an oath to his clan under his breath. Machi and Nobunaga, having been sent out as scouts to look for Uvogin, sit at a table outside in the city. They argue over whether Uvogin is dead, although both are left worried and uncertain. The woman and man who tipped off Leorio and his friends about the sighting of the two Spiders sit across from Machi and Nobunaga at another table, showing a live video of the Spiders to Leorio, Killua, and Gon. The trio wire the payment to the couple, who take off once they are no longer needed. The trio, sitting not too far away, debate whether or not they stand a chance against the two Spiders. Killua is certain that the trio have no chance of winning and is also certain that the two Spiders know they are being watched. Sure enough, Nobunaga and Machi discuss the people watching them, certain they are being spied on but uncertain of by whom. They argue about what they'll do with Kurapika if it turns out to be him, heated enough that the trio can feel the tension between them from where they are sitting. Nobunaga and Machi decide to flip a coin to determine whether they will bring Kurapika in dead or alive to Chrollo. Back at the hotel, Light arrives and thanks the bodyguards for keeping his daughter safe. Light says that Neon will be going home, since there is no point in her being there with the auction canceled, and Neon begrudgingly agrees and goes to pack her things. Light instructs Melody and Basho to escort Neon home. Once Neon is out of the room, Light discusses the plans for the reopening auction that night with the bodyguards, informing them that the Ten Dons plan to reacquire the stolen auction goods, which are likely in the hands of the Phantom Troupe now that all of the Shadow Beasts have been killed. Light also informs them that the Ten Dons have hired professionals to take care of the Phantom Troupe; Zeno and Silva arrive in Yorknew City. Light asks Kurapika to join the team of assassins in taking down the Phantom Troupe due to his abilities specifically being for targeting Spiders. Outside the city, Machi and Nobunaga get up and leave their table. Killua tells Gon that they will follow the two Spiders since they can conceal themselves with Zetsu. Leorio, unable to use Zetsu, is instructed by Killua to go check in with Zepile. Gon and Killua split up to tail Machi and Nobunaga, communicating with each other via cellphone. Killua watches the two Spiders closely and doesn't believe that they know he and Gon are following them. Machi and Nobunaga talk about how they are likely being followed, but can't tell if it's true. Machi and Nobunaga head into the deserted part of the city, and Killua is unsure whether it is a trap or not; he decides to continue following them anyways. Machi and Nobunaga stand out in the open, unable to agree on who they believe is following them or if they are still being followed. Gon and Killua, who are hiding in different locations in the area, talk over their phones and decide to wait and see what the two Spiders are going to do. Nobunaga gets a call on his cell from one of the other Spiders, and during his conversation, Pakunoda and Phinks find Gon and Killua, who try and make a run for it. Killua gets cornered by Nobunaga and Phinks, who informed both Killua and Nobunaga that the rest of the Spiders were actually tracking Gon and Killua the whole time. Gon gets cornered by Machi and Pakunoda.

Episode 58 (2011) Signal × To × Retreat (ヒキギワ×ノ×ヒキガネ, "Hikigiwa × No × Hikigane") is the 58th episode of the Hunter × Hunter 2011 series. It first aired on December 9th, 2012. Overview. "As Pakunoda meets Kurapika, she is told to bring Gon and Killua to exchange hostages. After the trade, Chrollo is now free, and Hisoka challenges him to a duel." Summary. Pakunoda finally arrives at the designated place. After Melody verifies her, Kurapika gives two conditions for both Pakunoda and Chrollo. The first rule for Chrollo is that he is forbidden to use Nen, and the second is that he may not contact any member of the Phantom Troupe. Before placing the second condition, he searches his mind hard for an alternative but fails to find one. He then claims that his top priority is to get Gon and Killua back. To make certain that he adheres to those conditions, he uses his Judgment Chain on him. After Pakunoda accepts the conditions, Kurapika puts the chain on Chrollo. He then gives Pakunoda's conditions; the first is that she must release Gon and Killua unharmed, before midnight and without any tricks. Second, she may not speak a single word about him. She accepts it and Kurapika puts the chain on her. Kurapika tells her to bring back Gon and Killua to exchange hostages. Pakunoda agrees and she heads back to their hideout. At the Troupe's hideout, Phinks insists Pakunoda to tell him the chain user's location, and that he won't let her leave before telling him. However, Pakunoda refuses and says that she will take the kids alone, making Phinks angry. Machi tells her to leave, and that she and Kortopi will stop them. Feitan implies that Pakunoda, Machi, and Kortopi are probably under the chain user's control. Gon suddenly interferes by saying that Machi and Pakunoda are just trying to save their leader. Phinks and Gon start arguing until Franklin stops them. Franklin tells Phinks to let Pakunoda go and reminds the Troupe that the worst-case scenario is if the whole Phantom Troupe were to die and the Spider perishes, and if their arguing causes the Phantom Troupe to fall apart, that would be the worst betrayal against their boss, so Franklin proposes that Pakunoda can take the kids to the chain-user and boss does not return, then they could kill the controlled members and start rebuilding the Spider. This proposal is quickly agreed upon by Machi, although she claims that she is not being controlled and that killing her won't be easy. Suddenly, the phone rings and Phinks answers it. On the line, Kurapika asks to talk to the hostages. Phinks throws the phone with some force at Gon, much to Shalnark's anger, since they are using his phone. Kurapika asks about their current situation, to which Gon replies quickly and throws the phone back to Phinks, upsetting Shalnark again. Phinks then tells Kurapika that they are following his orders. Kurapika watches as Pakunoda and the boys go back to his place, until he suddenly sees Hisoka. He phones Kurapika and asks to allow him to go inside the airship along with the hostages. He claims that his target is the boss, and that he wants to fight him. As the airships land, both parties meet. After verifying that Gon and Killua are not being manipulated, they begin the exchange. Kurapika and the others leave immediately after that; however, the spiders are still there.
