However, Killua notes that it isn't the place to use it and it wouldn't work on the two Spiders since they are checking people's faces and demeanors. Killua tells them to smile and act natural, but Leorio and Gon's attempt at doing so causes Killua to change his mind. Nobunaga says that they should decide whether to take the chain user dead or alive, and Machi flips a coin up in the air, with Nobunaga calling heads and Machi tails. At the Hotel Beitacle, Kurapika and the remaining Nostrade bodyguards explain the situation to Light, who praises Kurapika's quick thinking to move Neon to a new room. He is confident that he Troupe is using the Hunter Website to track them and thanks Kurapika for keeping Neon safe. He tells them that he is sending Neon home and asks her if she is fine with it. She wonders if she even has a choice, but realizes that there's no point anymore since the items were stolen and the auction is canceled. Light assures her that there will be an auction next year and promises to make the thieves return the items she wanted. Light then addresses Basho and Melody and tells them to take Neon back to the mansion, worried about their safety since they were seen but adding that their pictures aren't on the Hunter Website. He tells the two to put on disguises just in case and asks Neon to go to her room and pack her things. After the three leave the room, Light reveals to the others that the auction will reopen tonight at the same place and time since the Mafia doesn't want to appear weak. He adds that the Ten Dons have sworn to get the stolen items back, but one of the guards speaks up and says that the Shadow Beasts got the items before the Troupe could steal them. Light tells them that the Shadow Beasts were all killed, explaining that nine bodies were found and Owl was most likely kidnapped. He says that the Dons are aware of what Nen can do and have assumed that the auction items are in the Troupe's possession since Owl wouldn't even need to be tortured if one of the Troupe members has the power to extract information from their target. As the four guards continue to listen in silence, Light tells them that the Dons have hired professionals to kill the Troupe. Elsewhere, Silva and Zeno Zoldyck are seen on the move as Light says that the Mafia only uses murder for intimidation and that it's better to have experts handle the actual thing. He explains that the Dons have hired a team of assassins to take care of the Troupe, and since they don't want them to receive all the credit, he asks Kurapika to join them. Back in the market square, Killua notices that the two Troupe members are on the move and asks what they should do, reminding them that they can't beat them in a fight. Leorio says that they have to find a way and Gon adamantly adds that they can't turn back. Reluctantly agreeing, Killua says that they have to do exactly as he says.

Chapter 9 A Struggle in the Mist (のの, "Kiri no Naka no Kōbō") is the 9th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As several examinees lie dead or dying on the ground, Hisoka continues to shuffle his cards and tells the others that while he planned to wait until the Second Phase, he wanted to play examiner during the First Phase since it's so boring. The examinees are left stunned, but one angrily speaks up and says that since they have lost sight of Satotz in the fog, they have all failed, including Hisoka. However, Hisoka tells him that he's wrong and quickly kills him with a playing card to the head, confidently adding that a magician never runs out of tricks. Many examinees quickly surround Hisoka with their weapons drawn, with one saying that someone so homicidal doesn't deserve to be a Hunter and another warning him that it will be his last Hunter Exam. Hisoka then draws a four of hearts from his deck of cards and declares that it will be the only one he needs. The examinees become enraged at the remark and charge toward him to attack, but Hisoka easily dodges their strikes and uses the single card to slice their necks and faces. With Kurapika and Leorio looking on in horror, Hisoka continues his massacre and begins to chuckle before laughing maniacally as the terrified examinees try to run away. After killing nearly everyone and calling them dropouts, he begins walking toward the remaining three of the group: Kurapika, Leorio, and Cherry. The three stand motionless as Kurapika holds his ready, and Cherry whispers that splitting up is their only chance of survival, given Hisoka's superiority over them. He recognizes that they both have their own reasons for wanting to become Hunters and would prefer not to flee, but he stresses that it's the only reasonable option. Once Cherry gives the signal, the three turn and run away in different directions toward the fog. Hisoka praises their strategy and gives them a head start of ten seconds, counting down and then wondering who he should chase after first. However, Leorio suddenly appears out of the fog holding a piece of wood and having put his tie around the wound on his arm. He vows to get payback and charges forward with the weapon, with Kurapika and Cherry unable to believe that he went back. Hisoka tells Leorio that he likes his spirit and easily dodges the strike, preparing to attack him from behind, but the hook from Gon's fishing rod suddenly strikes Hisoka in the face. Leorio is stunned that Gon came back for him, and Hisoka smiles at the motionless Gon, praising his strike and impressed that he's using a fishing rod. As Hisoka begins walking toward Gon to get a closer look, Leorio tries to attack him from behind, but Hisoka uppercuts him in the face and sends him flying in the air. Gon immediately charges forward and tries to strike him with his fishing rod, but Hisoka somehow disappears right in front of his eyes and then puts his hand around his throat, praising Gon's loyalty to his friend. Putting on a smile and removing his hand, Hisoka assures Gon that Leorio is still alive and has passed, happily telling Gon that he has passed as well and will make a good Hunter. A communication and GPS device suddenly beeps, and someone tells Hisoka to hurry up since the Second Phase is about to start. Hisoka acknowledges the message and replies that he will be there shortly. He then stresses to Gon how important friendship is and picks up the unconscious Leorio to carry over his shoulder, asking Gon if he will be okay on his own. After Gon replies yes with a simple nod, Hisoka calls him a good boy and chuckles as he disappears through the fog. Gon quickly falls to his knees as Kurapika runs up behind him to ensure he's okay. As his heartbeat quickens, it's stated that Gon has never met a creature as strange and mysterious as Hisoka.

Chapter 90 September 3rd: Part 6 (93⑥, "Kugatsu Mikka (Roku)") is the 90th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Killua says that he and Gon will use Zetsu to track the two Phantom Troupe members. As Killua uses the Nen technique, Leorio says to himself that Killua seemed to fade right in front of him and compares it to him turning transparent. Killua stresses to Gon that they will retreat if they are spotted or if he deems it impossible to follow them any further. He says that he will ring once if he decides to abort the plan, telling Gon to answer on the second call and to put his phone on vibrate. He adds that if the Spiders separate, they will follow the woman. Finally, he tells Leorio to contact Zepile and help him with the auction. When asked if he has any tracking experience, Gon says that he followed Hisoka during the Hunter Exam, and Killua is impressed that he was able to do so without being noticed. Gon adds that he tracked him for an entire day, impressing Leorio as well and causing Killua to punch him in the back of the head. A confused Gon wonders why he hit him, and Killua just tells him that he passes, adding that they need to stay out of the Spiders' field of vision. Killua watches the Spiders from a rooftop and calls Gon to tell him that they are leaving the plaza and going down a narrow street. Gon asks if they have been spotted, but Killua assures him that they will be fine while using Zetsu, adding that they still need to be careful since the Spiders are expecting to be followed. After hanging up, Killua worries that Gon doesn't realize that it would be immediately over if they were spotted. He continues to look for any changes in their behavior and says that most people wouldn't be able to notice them. He tells himself that he wouldn't miss their heart skipping a beat, reminding himself he has been playing life-or-death games since he was three years old. Machi asks if they're being followed, and guessing that they are, Nobunaga describes their Zetsu as perfect (with Machi agreeing). As the Spiders move into an abandoned part of the city, Killua at first worries that they are being led into a trap, but assures himself that they aren't aware of their presence. He considers the possibility that they are heading back to their hideout, deciding to abort the plan if it's a trap and keep following if it's their hideout. Sweat begins to pour down his face as he wonders which it is, telling himself that they have to keep going for now. The two Spiders stop in the middle of an abandoned plaza, and Machi says that the followers aren't taking the bait. Nobunaga guesses that it's not the chain user since he probably works alone. Machi wonders how he reached that conclusion, and Nobunaga replies that he works for the Nostrade Family and probably fought Uvogin alone. He points out that if the Mafia were involved with Uvogin's death, they would have posted an image of his severed head on the web. He guesses that the chain user didn't report his killing of Uvogin to the Mafia because it was a personal vendetta. Machi tells him that he is guessing too much, but Nobunaga remains confident that the followers are not connected to the chain user. Machi says that his logic is faulty and that they are somehow connected to him. Hiding in the dilapidated buildings nearby, Killua calls Gon and says that they are either meeting someone there or trying to draw them out. Gon wonders if they have been spotted, and Killua says that if they have, they will tell them to show themselves. As Killua tells Gon that they will wait a little longer, Nobunaga's phone suddenly rings and Killua says that he is going to hang up, stressing to Gon that the next time he calls, they make a run for it. Nobunaga asks Phinks what's going on and tells him that they are being followed, adding that the people won't show themselves. Phinks asks if he wants a hint, and after a couple seconds, Nobunaga suddenly looks right toward Gon and Killua. The two boys immediately dart away to escape, but Phinks stops Killua from leaving and Pakunoda stands waiting for Gon. Killua quickly darts around the room, but Phinks grabs him by his right ankle to stop his movement. Killua flings several rocks toward Phinks' face, but the Spider easily dodges them. As Killua readies a kick with his left leg, Phinks realizes that the rocks were decoys and blocks the attack, now holding onto both of Killua's ankles as the boy is left standing upside down. Killua twists his body and escapes Phinks' grip, leaving him impressed as the skin is torn from Killua's ankles. Nobunaga suddenly appears in the window and asks what Phinks is doing there since he was with Chrollo, leaving Killua stunned since they're on the building's fourth floor. Phinks replies that he had to deceive them to deceive the followers, and Nobunaga says that he knew there were too many Zetsu masters around. Killua realizes that they were being tailed as well and that they're now trapped. As Nobunaga tells Killua that he has some questions to ask, Machi joins Pakunoda in cornering Gon.

Chapter 91 September 3rd: Part 7 (93⑦, "Kugatsu Mikka (Nana)") is the 91st chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Pakunoda and Machi begin walking closer to Gon, with the former asking if he knows the chain user and the latter asking if a Nen user with a chain told him to pursue them. A confused Gon replies that he doesn’t know and that they were tracking them on their own, telling himself that he only needs a second to create an opening and escape. Machi asks Pakunoda what she thinks, and she replies that he's good if he's lying, adding that she will check anyway. In another dilapidated building, Nobunaga first asks Killua why he was following them, with Phinks telling him to keep his answer short. Killua realizes that even a small lie won't work and replies that after the Mafia put a bounty on their heads, various websites started offering rewards for their location. Nobunaga then asks who taught him how to shadow, and Killua says that they were just using Zetsu, adding that he is training to be a professional Hunter. Nobunaga asks who taught him, and Killua replies that it was the assistant master of Shingen-ryu "kung fu". Nobunaga then asks if he knows a Nen user with chains who is a Conjurer or Manipulator. Phinks asks if he or his teacher has multiple chains on his right hand. Killua says that he has no idea and that his teacher is an Enhancer who only taught them the Four Basic Principles. Finally, Nobunaga tells Killua to choose whether he wants to die now or later, giving him three seconds to answer. Back in the other building, as Pakunoda's phone suddenly rings, Gon tries to make a quick escape, but Machi instantly appears right behind him with her hands on his shoulders, telling him not to try anything. Pakunoda tells the person on the phone that they will be right over, revealing to Gon that his friend came quietly. After Gon, Killua, and the four Phantom Troupe members arrive at the group's hideout by car, Killua asks himself if they should even be there, but then says that the group isn't all that different from his family. After Pakunoda welcomes them and opens the large doors to the main room, Gon and Killua see seven of the other members. Hisoka pretends not to know them, and Killua does the same for Hisoka, wondering if he might help them. Gon, however, is audibly surprised to see Hisoka and catches the attention of the others, with Nobunaga asking if he recognizes someone. Killua looks around and realizes that they met the other female member before, pointing her out as she reads a book. Phinks asks Shizuku if she knows them, and while she replies that she doesn't, Feitan remembers that she arm-wrestled Gon. Franklin reminds her that she lost to him a couple days ago, and Feitan points out that Shizuku never remembers anything she has forgotten. Shizuku says that she would never lose to a kid, and Franklin says that she used her right hand. Shizuku is confused since she's left-handed, and Franklin says that it's his mistake. Nobunaga asks Gon if he really beat Shizuku at arm-wrestling, and Killua says that he didn't know she was in the Troupe. Tying back his hair, Nobunaga challenges Gon and easily wins the first match, telling him to go again as the back of Gon's hand is already bloody from being slammed against the table. As Nobunaga continues to win, he asks the others where he ranks in arm-wrestling within the Troupe, and Franklin replies that he's seventh or eighth, with Machi saying that he's not weak but not one of the strongest. Nobunaga tells Gon that the strongest was someone named Uvogin and that he was probably killed by the chain user. Killua adamantly reminds him that they don't know who the person is, and Nobunaga sternly tells Killua that he will kill him the next time he speaks like that, slamming Gon's hand down against the table once again. As Gon struggles to raise his bruised and bloody hand, Nobunaga adds that Uvogin was an Enhancer and loved to fight, saying that he would punish him and Franklin for being late. As he reveals that they have been together since before the Troupe formed and that he knows him better than anyone, Nobunaga begins to cry and says that the chain user must have used a trick since Uvogin wouldn't have lost a fair fight. He promises to find him regardless of how many people he has to kill, adding that the chain user probably holds a grudge against them and was recently hired by the Nostrade Family. Killua begins to worry as he puts the pieces together, and Nobunaga says that they may have heard rumors, warning them not to hide anything they know. Gon replies that even if he did know, he would never tell them. Nobunaga is left confused and Killua stunned, but Gon explains that while he initially thought the Troupe was a group of heartless people, he now knows that they can grieve for their friends. As his aura swells around him and he grips Nobunaga's hand even tighter, he angrily asks why they can't share some of their empathy with all the people they have killed, suddenly slamming Nobunaga's hand down against the table.

Chapter 92 September 3rd: Part 8 (93⑧, "Kugatsu Mikka (Hachi)") is the 92nd chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. After Gon slams Nobunaga's hand down and wins the round of arm-wrestling, Feitan quickly appears behind him and restrains his left arm. He tells Gon that he's too cocky and begins to apply pressure, but when Killua goes to intervene, Hisoka quickly appears behind him and holds one of his playing cards right at his throat, drawing a small drop of blood and threatening to kill him if he moves. Feitan asks Gon if he knows the chain user, and Gon angrily repeats that he doesn't know anything. Nobunaga tells the gleeful Feitan to stop, and Feitan asks what Nobunaga thinks he's going to do. Nobunaga says that he plans to break Gon's arm, but Feitan replies that he will start by ripping off his fingernails. Nobunaga again tells Feitan to stop, but Feitan says that he doesn't have to obey his orders. The two surround themselves with aura, and Franklin tells Nobunaga to calm down, with Machi and Shizuku reminding them that there’s no fighting within the Troupe. After Nobunaga remembers that they settle arguments with a coin toss, with Feitan calling tails and Nobunaga heads, the coin lands on heads and Feitan releases Gon. Shizuku asks the others what they should do with the boys, wondering if the two have been interrogated yet. Pakunoda says that they can go free if they don't know anything, and Franklin asks her what she thinks. She replies that she checked them out on the way over and that they have no memory of the chain user. Nobunaga tells Machi that her hunch was wrong, and Machi is surprised at first but says that Pakunoda has to be right. Killua asks Gon if they did anything to him, and Gon says that they only asked him a couple questions. Killua wonders to himself why the others trust Pakunoda's analysis so much, wondering what she did to them on the way over. As his mind lingers on the word memory and he remembers Pakunoda with her arm around his shoulder and asking him about a Nen user with chains, he realizes that she must have the ability to read memories while touching her target. However, Killua knows that they are finished if she checks him again, having figured out that Kurapika is the chain user. While Franklin and Shalnark agree that the boys can be let go if they don't know anything, Phinks speaks up and says that the two may not know him as the chain user, theorizing that the person may not openly show his chains. He adds that they should wait to release them until they learn who their leader is, but Shalnark replies that the chain user isn't their leader since he most likely works alone. Machi asks if he agrees with Nobunaga's assessment, and Shalnark says that he wouldn't need help from two kids when he has access to the information network of the Mafia. Although Feitan tells Gon that he can now go home to his mother, Nobunaga speaks up and says that they aren't leaving, suddenly asking Gon to join the Spiders. Gon quickly declines, and when Nobunaga says that they could team up, Gon furiously replies that he would rather die than join. Nobunaga chuckles and asks Gon if he's an Enhancer, and when Gon confirms this, Nobunaga busts out laughing and says that he wants to nominate Gon to Chrollo once he comes back. Phinks wonders if he's joking and Feitan adds that Chrollo won't agree to it. Machi says that it isn't their problem, and Phinks tells Nobunaga that he has to watch them on his own if he wants to keep them there. After Nobunaga moves Gon and Killua to watch them elsewhere, Shizuku says that they should have seen Mafia members by now and guesses that they stopped looking for them. However, Shalnark replies that they may be preparing for the next part of their plan, and Franklin says that their own plan of using the chain user as bait hasn't worked out. Shalnark tells them that it’s their turn to the go on the offensive, handing out a list of the Nostrade Family's employees he printed from the Hunter Website. He tells them to take special care in memorizing the faces of the five people who guard the daughter of the boss. He says that while Uvogin told him the chain user isn’t among them, those five were the ones who kidnapped him. As Shalnark adds that they need to find someone who knows what the chain user looks like, Shizuku points out that she killed a guy on the list, telling the others to cross him off. Shalnark tells the group to work in pairs and meet back at the hideout by 10 p.m. Machi asks him who she will team up with since Nobunaga is watching the kids, and as Shalnark tells her to work with whoever is left, she turns to look at a grinning Hisoka. In one of the building's rooms, Nobunaga sits in front of the door holding his katana. Gon deals with the pain from the arm-wrestling matches, and Killua realizes his mistake of trying to help Gon, saying that Hisoka would not have hesitated to kill him. As he wonders whether he could have stopped the Troupe if they had threatened Gon's life, the doubting voice of his older brother suddenly enters his mind and fills it with negative thoughts. After repeatedly telling him that he's wrong, Killua slowly stands up as his aura swells around him, leaving Gon confused.

Chapter 93 September 3rd: Part 9 (93⑨, "Kugatsu Mikka (Kyū)") is the 93rd chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. After Killua stands up with a serious look on his face, Nobunaga chuckles and coyly says that he's scared, readying his katana as his aura swells around him. He warns Killua that if he moves any closer, he will cut him down. Killua remains still as the sweat runs down his face, and a worried Gon gets his attention. Elsewhere, looking for the employees of the Nostrade Family in the city, Shizuku asks Franklin if he thinks Gon is very similar to Uvogin. Franklin replies that he is because it's very clear how he feels about something and he can easily lose his temper. He adds that Gon shows incredible strength when it's for someone else, saying that while Uvogin preferred to fight alone, he was at his strongest when he and Nobunaga were fighting together. Shizuku seems surprised by this, and Franklin says that Uvogin never admitted that he fought better when he was taking care of someone else. Shizuku compares the mentality to that of a loser, and Franklin says it's one way of putting it, realizing how direct she can be. Finally, while he says that Nobunaga was better at fighting one-on-one and would complain when he had to team up with Uvogin, he adds that he didn't seem to mind that much in the end. Still sporting the wounds on his ankles, Killua begins to sweat even more and finally grits his teeth in frustration, turning around and angrily punching the wall. He quickly sits down and says that they need to think of another way to fight him besides head-on. Gon says to himself that Nobunaga is guarding the only exit and that the room has no windows, wondering how they can get him away from the door. As time passes and it becomes night, Nobunaga lights some candles around himself, and Gon wonders how Leorio is doing, hoping that he was able to meet up with Zepile. He asks Killua if he's okay, and though he replies that he is, he keeps looking down at the floor and tenses up his muscles in frustration. Gon begins to think about the doctoring terms that Zepile taught them, remembering autopsy and cauterization and asking Killua what the last one was. Killua replies that he forgets, and as Gon tries to remember, Killua tells Gon that he will keep Nobunaga busy while he escapes. Gon is against the plan, and Nobunaga speaks up as well, telling Killua that he knows he won’t be able to catch him off guard. Killua analyzes the situation with himself and says that Nobunaga has a view of the entire room, able to hear everything they say and see everything they do. He guesses that he is a master of iaido and that his sword reach is twice as long as his own. As he considers taking the risk, he suddenly hears his older brother's voice again telling him that it's impossible. Killua suddenly stands up and tells him to shut up, saying that he won't know until he tries. Gon stands up as well and asks him what he plans to do. After Killua tells him that he will try to block Nobunaga's first strike so that he can escape, Gon suddenly punches him in the back of the head, leaving Killua stunned before he grabs him by the shirt and asks him why he hit him. Gon angrily tells him to stop thinking only about himself and trivializing death. Killua reminds him that he said the same thing earlier, and Gon declares that while he can say it, Killua can't. Killua is left confused and frustrated, causing Nobunaga to chuckle and say that reason doesn't work on Enhancers. Killua angrily orders Gon to stop telling him what to do in a life or death situation, saying that he doesn't even know how he feels. Gon replies that he must be too stupid to know, causing Nobunaga to bust out laughing before he becomes serious and tells them that he won't try anything as long as they don't. He assures them that they only have to stay until Chrollo returns and that they can go if he isn't interested in them, again warning them not to make him draw his sword. After Nobunaga threatens to split them in two if they try anything, the idea causes Gon to remember that the last term was called ostomy, reminding Killua that he was the one who figured it out. Killua suddenly understands Gon's plan, and the two begin smiling as they wonder how they didn't think of it sooner. With Nobunaga left confused, Gon and Killua suddenly glare at him and ready their Nen in preparation for something. Nobunaga puts his hand on his sword and says that he won't be able to avoid killing them if they get too close. Gon and Killua quickly dash toward him, but then suddenly dart toward the side walls, each of them kicking a hole through to escape. Nobunaga is left stunned, and the two boys remember that if the exit is blocked, you make a new opening.

Chapter 94 September 3rd: Part 10 (93⑩, "Kugatsu Mikka (Jū)") is the 94th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As Gon and Killua kick through the side walls, Nobunaga is left stunned by their plan and quickly wonders which one he should follow. He thinks about the building's layout and says that they are on the fifth floor, with Killua closest to the stairwell. As Nobunaga opens the door and decides to go after Gon, he hears the lock to the room next door click and instead heads through the hole that Gon used to escape. However, after hearing Gon and Killua smashing through more walls, he decides to follow Gon since Killua is making his way down the stairs. Nobunaga quickens his pace when he hears Gon smash through another wall, but is left surprised when he finds the final room empty and its door blocked. As he wonders if Gon is hiding, Gon suddenly shouts Killua's name from the hallway, and Nobunaga realizes that he used the last hole as a decoy, doubling back and then hiding before he escaped. Gon yells to Killua that they will fight Nobunaga together, but Nobunaga suddenly kicks down the door and clears the debris. He finds the hallway empty and doesn't sense their auras, offended that they would try to ambush him from the shadows. He then uses a technique called En, which is explained as an advanced application of Ten and Ren. It's added that while aura usually covers a Nen user's body with a layer no more than a few centimeters thick, En increases that layer to at least a few meters. Nobunaga says that he can sense the movement of everything within his 4-meter striking range, but as he waits for the boys to attack him, the two are seen already far away from the building. Killua calls Gon an idiot, but Gon replies that he really wanted to beat him. Killua assures him that Nobunaga would have easily killed them before they could even touch him since they only know the Nen basics. Gon gives a big smile and says that he's glad Killua is back to being himself, adding that he's relying on him since he's the reckless one. Gon then wonders what they should do next, declaring that he wants to fight them, and Killua remembers that three of the Phantom Troupe members are worth 6 billion in bounty money. However, he tells Gon that they first need to improve their Nen and that they should ask Kurapika. Gon wonders why, and Killua reveals that he's the chain user mentioned by the Troupe, surprised that Gon hadn't figured it out. He points out that Kurapika learned Nen at the same time as they did and stresses to Gon that they need unique abilities, adding that they need to be able to hold their own against the Troupe. As the two board a train to head back to the city, a hungry Milluki is also seen at a train station. Four hours before Gon and Killua escaped from Nobunaga, Neon is seen shopping at Lingon Airport as Melody and Basho struggle to carry all the items she bought. As the two bond over how draining it all is, Neon watches a group of girls going to the bathroom and says that she has to go, asking Melody and Basho to watch her things. Basho worries about Kurapika, and Melody says that her flute should make him feel less tired. He then asks about the hit job on the Troupe, and Melody says that Kurapika only agreed to join because he's willing to sacrifice everything for his goal. As the group of girls leaves the bathroom, Basho tells Melody that he just wants to ride his bike around the world, wondering why Neon is taking so long. Eliza offers to go check and suddenly comes running back out, telling them that no one is in there. Neon thanks the group of girls and takes off a black wig she had used as a disguise, telling herself that she always knows her father is lying when he uses the word "promise". As she decides to go to the auction by herself since he doesn't want to take her, a person holding a picture of Neon is seen watching her from behind.

Chapter 95 September 3rd: Part 11 (93⑪, "Kugatsu Mikka (Jū Ichi)") is the 95th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. At the Hotel Beitacle, six assassins wait in a room and are joined by Silva and Zeno Zoldyck. Several Mafia members also enter the room, and one named Zenji first points out that everyone seems to be there, but another tells him that the Nostrade Family is sending one more person. Zenji mocks Light, and another reminds him that his own boss depends on Neon's fortunes. Zenji replies that Light isn't his boss and adds that he can be aggravated if he wants to be. After Kurapika and Light finally join the meeting, Zenji starts by telling the group of assassins that their job is to kill the Phantom Troupe, warning that they may try to attack the auction again. He leaves the method to their discretion and says that they can ask if they need anything. Assassin D asks for a floor plan of the Cemetery Building, and Assassin E asks for a map. The former says that they should pick code names, with the latter adding that colors should work. Assassin F asks to be called "Blue", and Assassin C says that he wants to be "Red". Zeno dryly remarks that they're acting like it's a game, and Assassin D asks them what colors they want. However, Silva and Zeno simply give their names and tell the others to call them what they want, stressing that they won't be taking orders from them. Assassin F realizes that they are the legendary Zoldycks that no one has ever seen, shocked that they actually use their real last name. Zeno gives him a card with their address and phone number, offering him a 30% discount if he needs anyone killed. Kurapika understands that the two are from Killua's family, also recognizing that they are clearly more intimidating than the others and that the only ones who can compete with them are Assassin A and Assassin B. Assassin A scoffs at the idea of code names and says that they should all work alone. Assassin B agrees and says that they each have their own style, adding that he will do what he wants. Assassin D worries that working alone may be too dangerous against the Troupe, and Assassin E agrees that they need at least some teamwork in order to succeed. Assassin A asks for Kurapika's opinion, and he notes that poor teamwork would only be detrimental, telling the others to get help from the Mafia members if they need it. Zenji tells the group that they will be escorted inside the building since only a few people are aware that they will be there. A Mafia member offers Silva a floor plan, but he refuses it, with Zeno telling him that they will see it for themselves. Zenji approaches Light and asks him how things are going. Light replies that things are going fine, but Zenji takes the opportunity to comment on how quickly Light has risen up the ranks. He then asks about his hands and says that he heard he was rubbing them together so much that he got burns and rubbed off his fingerprints. As Zenji and his men laugh together, Light chuckles and says that jealousy is pathetic, causing Zenji to fly into a rage and punch Light several times in the face. However, Kurapika suddenly appears behind him with a switchblade at his throat. Zenji dares him to try and stab him, and Light quickly tells Kurapika to stop as Zenji's men take their boss away from Light. As the three leave, Light tells Kurapika that many people resent his recent success because of how incompetent they are. He adds that information is the most important asset and that it's most valuable when it's about the future, declaring that he can rule the world if he possesses accurate precognition. Planning to rise to the top while making more enemies, he tells Kurapika that he expects great things from him and that he will be well rewarded. As the two head by car to the Cemetery Building and policemen are seen checking each vehicle, Light tells Kurapika that the Mafia paid for 60% of the mayor's election campaign, explaining that since the police chief does whatever the mayor says, they can easily impose traffic restrictions to create a safe perimeter around the building. Kurapika's phone suddenly rings, and Melody urgently tells him that Neon disguised herself and ran away. Kurapika calmly tells her that he has a good idea of where she went, asking her and Basho to wait for them back at the hotel. Light almost chokes on his cigar when he learns about Neon running away, but Kurapika assures him that she is heading to the auction as well, guessing that she realized he lied to her about it being canceled. After trying to call her and just getting her voicemail, Light calls someone and tells them to have every checkpoint be on the lookout for his daughter, telling them to detain a 17- to 18-year-old girl who tries to enter without a pass. As he gives a more detailed description, the policemen scan a man's pass and give him the go-ahead. With the two of them sitting in the back of the car, Neon thanks Chrollo for getting her through. A policeman calls Light and tells him that a girl with different hair and clothes tried to pass the checkpoint without a pass five minutes ago. He adds that she was alone and mentioned her father before having the taxi turn around. Light urgently tells them to detain her if she shows up again, calling someone else and telling them to put out an A.P.B. and to print out his daughter's picture. The worried Light sits in silence, and Kurapika calmly asks if he should go looking for her, wondering if he has a map of the city as he readies his Dowsing Chain. Chrollo and Neon are seen waiting at a restaurant until the start of the auction, and the homeless man that Chrollo hired to drive the car tells him that he will wait there. Chrollo praises Neon's ability as a fortuneteller and says that he can't remember who told him about it. Neon says that many important people want to have their fortunes told, and Chrollo asks how accurate she is. Neon replies that others say she's always right, explaining that the process is automatic and her hand writes by itself. Chrollo eagerly asks if she can tell his fortune, and she tells him to write down his full name, birthday, and blood type. After he does so, she says that "Chrollo Lucilfer" is an unusual name, also surprised to see that he is 26 years old. He replies that his friends seem to like it, causing Neon to laugh and call him odd. Once she begins to use her ability, Chrollo's eyes suddenly sharpen and become serious. Using his Dowsing Chain above a map of the city, Kurapika tells Light that Neon is already in the Cemetery Building. As the two quickly head there by car, Chrollo continues to watch Neon intently as she writes out his fortune.

Chapter 96 September 3rd: Part 12 (93⑫, "Kugatsu Mikka (Jū Ni)") is the 96th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. After Neon finishes writing out his fortune and hands it to him, Chrollo asks if he can read it. She explains that her fortunes have four or five sections which describe what will happen each week of the current month, telling him that the things mentioned in the first section may have already happened. Chrollo first reads about a precious moon being lost and others mourning him. The second section mentions bloody Scarlet Eyes and Chrollo losing half his number, with the last section telling him to seek out new friends and find the one he needs most in the east. Chrollo begins to cry and says that her fortune is amazing and accurate, but when he tries to ask her a question about the first section, Neon quickly stops him and explains that she never looks at her fortunes, feeling that they will be more accurate if she doesn't. Chrollo says that parts of the poem are about the soul resting forever, asking if she believes in an afterlife. Neon replies that she doesn't and that fortunes are meant to comfort those who are alive. Chrollo says that she may be right, and Neon tells him that she's just repeating the words of a famous fortuneteller, who said that fortunes should make people happy so that they are more likely to improve their lives and avoid misfortune. Chrollo asks if she's referring to the Galactic Matron and points out that she was later arrested for being a fraud. Neon says that it still made her want to grow up to be a fortuneteller, and Chrollo adds that she also didn't believe in an afterlife. Neon replies that it's partly why she doesn't, and Chrollo tells her that because he believes that people have souls, he wants to fulfill the wish of his fallen comrade. As Neon asks what the wish was, Chrollo suddenly strikes her on the back of the neck and whispers that it's to create chaos. With the Mafia members watching in confusion, Chrollo pretends that Neon fell unconscious and urgently tells them to call a doctor. One of them sends out the message, but Bean tells him that no one without a pass can enter the building, saying that they will meet them at the main entrance and drive them to the hospital personally. Still continuing his act, Chrollo angrily worries that moving her may make her condition worse, pointing out that the girl is Neon Nostrade and warning them that they will have to deal with her father. After he remembers that even the Dons are her fans, Bean begrudgingly tells the others to call an ambulance. Inside the same surveillance room, Assassin A asks the man at the monitor if he can rewind the footage of Neon collapsing. He realizes that Chrollo used the quickest strike that most would have missed, chuckling and feeling excited at finding new prey. After Light and Kurapika arrive, they are told that Neon is resting in Room 501. Light wonders how she got inside since she shouldn't have been able to get a pass, and Kurapika asks if she knows anyone in the Mafia. Light is adamant that besides her fortunetelling, he kept her away from the business. As Light heads to the fifth floor, Kurapika checks the Hunter Website and finds a picture of Neon. He also sees pictures of Basho and Baise along with the other Nostrade guards, realizing that they were added in just the past couple of hours. Light is in disbelief that Neon's picture is on the website, and Kurapika guesses that someone saw it and brought her to the building, with Light vowing to find and kill the person. Kurapika calms him down and reminds him that getting Neon to safety should be their priority. He guesses that the perpetrator wanted her as a backup hostage just in case the pass didn't gain him access. He worries about staying in the building and says that he told Melody and the others to join them, asking Light to stay with his daughter. Light wonders about the auction, and Kurapika reveals that it will be canceled again because the place will become a battlefield. Elsewhere in the building, Assassin A follows the scent of a blood trail left on purpose and wiped up to leave just enough behind. He inhales the scent and says that only a select few predators are able to detect it. He spots the tortured Assassin F tied to a chair and throws a knife into his chest to make sure that he's dead. Chrollo peers out from behind the corpse and reveals himself, assuring the assassin that he won't use any boring traps. As Chrollo pulls out a pen from Assassin F's head, he asks that they fight one-on-one and Assassin A agrees, holding a large knife in his hand and readying his aura. Elsewhere, Feitan receives a call from Chrollo telling them to come to the Cemetery Building and wreak havoc. As Phinks breaks the neck of one of the Mafia members, he says that they are almost there and asks where the other Spiders are. Feitan replies that they are all heading there and killing any guards standing in the way. He then says that Chrollo added a strange order to the mission, and Phinks asks what it was. Feitan reveals that they are to make a big show of the massacre. Back at the Troupe's hideout, Nobunaga is seen laughing as Gon and Killua argue.

Chapter 97 September 3rd: Part 13 (93⑬, "Kugatsu Mikka (Jū San)") is the 97th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Sweating and breathing heavily, Assassin A laughs and asks why he's still alive as his body is shown in pieces up against the wall, with Chrollo holding a book in his hand as a Nen beast flies around him. At one of the checkpoints outside the Cemetery Building, Shizuku and Franklin drive past the barricade and cause the policemen to jump out of the way. One of the Mafia members gives an order over the radio, and the car suddenly explodes, with the man telling them to report it as an accident. However, the Mafia members who surrounded the flaming wreckage are quickly gunned down by Franklin, who laughs maniacally as he continues killing everyone nearby with his Double Machine Gun. Phinks and Feitan slowly approach several Mafia members, causing them to draw their guns as they order the two to leave immediately. However, the two suddenly disappear right in front of them, with Feitan decapitating several of them and Phinks twisting the heads of the rest. Shalnark is seen hiding behind one of the Mafia members as he is riddled with bullets, and Pakunoda meets up with him. Hearing the gunfire all around the perimeter, several Mafia members run to see what's happening and find the others floating in the air like marionettes. Hiding nearby, Machi strings up two more and forces the puppets to fire upon their comrades. Hisoka is seen standing on a rooftop in the distance and enjoying the chaos. Back in the Cemetery Building, Chrollo explains to Assassin A that the Nen beasts are called Indoor Fish and can only exist in a closed room. He adds that they are carnivores that prefer human flesh and tells him that it's the reason why he isn't feeling pain or bleeding out. After Chrollo opens the large window, the Indoor Fish suddenly vanish and cause Assassin A's bloody corpse to fall to the floor in pieces. Chrollo closes his ominous book and begins acting like an orchestra conductor, hearing the carnage below and asking Uvogin if he can hear it as well. He dedicates the requiem to him and continues to conduct as the Phantom Troupe rampages through the Mafia. The panicked Mafia members wonder how many enemies there are and make sure not to let them near the building. An ambulance suddenly pulls up, but when the doctor and two workers approach and ask where the patient is, the Mafia members surround them with guns drawn as Bean warns them not to try anything. Inside the building, Kurapika sees several members panicking over the attack and wondering what will happen to the auction. As he realizes that the organizers will inevitably lose control of the situation, his phone suddenly rings with a call from Gon, who reveals that he and Killua were caught by the Troupe. Kurapika angrily reprimands them and stresses how dangerous the group is. Killua asks for the phone and tells Kurapika that they now realize how much stronger the Spiders are. Both Gon and Killua ask for his help, but Kurapika tells them that it isn't a game and refuses to help in their suicide. Killua asks if he wants to know where their hideout is, but Kurapika replies that he already has sources. Killua then says that they know some of their abilities, but Kurapika again refuses and repeats that they stay away from the group. Killua points out that the Troupe is now targeting him after he killed one of their own, sharply telling him that they will do whatever it takes to get his help if he doesn't think of them as friends or equals. He gives the phone to Gon, who tells Kurapika that he saw one of them cry over his friend's death and say that he would never forgive the killer. He adds that it made him both sad and angry, telling Kurapika that they want to stop the Troupe as well. As Gon again asks for his help, Kurapika reluctantly tells him that he will call them back.

Chapter 98 September 3rd: Part 14 (93⑭, "Kugatsu Mikka (Jū Yon)") is the 98th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Standing at the entrance of the Cemetery Building, Kurapika looks at his phone and remembers Gon and Killua's words about wanting to help him against the Phantom Troupe. He and several Mafia members outside suddenly see a large explosion in the distance and run to see what happened. A fellow Mafia member stumbles out with his gun drawn and says that they were helpless against the powerful group, suddenly firing toward his comrades to show how powerful the Troupe is. Kurapika dives for cover as the bullets rip through many of the Mafia members. As the rogue Mafia member laughs maniacally and continues to fire upon his comrades, it's revealed that he's being controlled by Shalnark with a cell phone-like device, sitting in a nearby tree and watching a first-person perspective on the screen. The Mafia member is finally killed, causing the screen to go blank, and a disappointed Shalnark says that he needs to look for another puppet with his Black Voice ability. Back inside the Cemetery Building, a worried Bean is seen talking with someone on the phone and asking where reinforcements are. He suddenly hears the sounds of gunfire and destruction over the phone, and looks out the window to see a large explosion, worrying that the 2,000 armed men are all being killed. As the destruction is shown all around the building, Bean runs for cover and tells someone by phone to contact the Ten Dons immediately. Many of the Mafia members angrily ask for their weapons back as they begin to panic over the chaos outside. However, at the top of the staircase, Silva punches the wall to get their attention and Zeno introduces himself, leaving them stunned that the Dons would call on the Zoldycks. Zeno reveals that one of the perpetrators is inside the building and that many of the hired assassins are already dead. He explains that he could kill them all in less than seven seconds even if they had their weapons, adding that the enemy is equally skilled and telling them to stay calm for now. After Silva finds Assassin D dead and determines that he was killed by a single strike with no bloodlust from the killer, Zeno begrudgingly says that he will need to use En and suggests that they start on the roof and corner the attacker in the basement. Silva points out that he would need to cover a radius of 100 meters, and Zeno replies that he can easily cover 300 meters, adding that they're not getting paid enough for the job. The two Zoldycks work their way down the building and, after entering a large ballroom, find Chrollo standing on the stage. After Silva warns his father that Chrollo can steal people's abilities, the three suddenly begin fighting as Silva throws a kick that Chrollo dodges and Zeno follows up with a series of strikes, one of which draws blood from Chrollo's left cheek. As Chrollo leaps back from Zeno, Silva follows up with a strong right punch which Chrollo blocks. However, Zeno takes advantage of this by shooting out a blast of aura, disorienting Chrollo as Silva drops down from above to crush him. Chrollo quickly rolls out of the way and pulls out a blade, moving forward to strike and forcing Silva to leap back. Although the blade is broken, it's shown to have cut Silva's left arm. As Chrollo catches his breath and says to himself that fighting against two people is difficult, Silva recognizes that the blade is a Ben's knife and suddenly realizes that it's toxic based on the shape, tearing out some of his hair and wrapping it around his arm to stop the poison from flowing through his body. Zeno checks on his son, and Silva replies that it's no problem. A smiling Chrollo says to himself that 0.1 mg of the poison would paralyze a whale. Zeno remembers what Silva told him and guesses that Chrollo is a Specialist, adding that he must need to meet four or five conditions to steal an ability. Chrollo confirms this internally and realizes how dangerous his opponent will be. Zeno also guesses that Chrollo won't try to steal their abilities during combat since it will be impossible to meet the conditions, pointing out that his use of the knife proves this. Realizing that he has no other choice, Chrollo tosses away the knife and readies his aura around himself. Zeno tells his son to cover him and kill Chrollo once he pins him down, even if he has to kill him as well.

Chapter 99 September 3rd: Part 15 (93⑮, "Kugatsu Mikka (Jū Go)") is the 99th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As the destruction from the Phantom Troupe continues outside the Cemetery Building and several Mafia members are seen lying dead in the street, the Zoldycks continue their fight against Chrollo, with Zeno slowly approaching him and focusing his aura into his hand. Chrollo recognizes this and realizes that he won't be able to guard against a strike with such potential, suddenly summoning his book and using his Skill Hunter ability. He opens the book to a page with Owl's image on it and conjures his Fun Fun Cloth. Zeno worries about the conjured cloak and guesses that it's a stolen ability, assuring himself that Chrollo is only using it to buy time. After activating his Dragon Head, he then uses his Dragon Lance to send out the dragon-shaped mass of aura. Chrollo dodges the initial strike, but Zeno chuckles and quickly redirects it toward him, with Chrollo unable to avoid the strike completely as it grazes his side. Zeno realizes that Chrollo's conjured book allows him to trap abilities and access them as long as he holds the book open. Although Chrollo moves closer toward him with the cloak, Zeno tells himself that it doesn't seem like he plans to attack, guessing that the cloak only activates when the target is close enough or it's used to counterattack. He adds that they only need to keep their distance and wait for their chance to strike. As Zeno's attacks continue to keep him back, Chrollo is impressed that Zeno instantly figured out his plan, closing his book once he realizes that he will be unable to capture him alive. Silva notes that the ability disappears when the book is closed, impressed that Chrollo is able to watch him while still barely dodging Zeno's attacks. He remembers his previous encounter with Chrollo and realizes how much he has improved, thinking that they may have to die to stop him. As Silva expands his aura and draws Chrollo's attention, Zeno captures him with his Dragon Lance and pins him against a wall. He follows up with a flurry of punches as Chrollo attempts to block them. Zeno suddenly yells out for his son to do it, and after quickly leaping into the air, Silva summons two large orbs of aura around each of his hands and releases them. After the blast shakes the entire building, Kurapika and Light are left wondering what the cause was.

Character Song Collection The Character Song Collection is a collection of songs sung by voice actors of the "Hunter × Hunter" 2011 anime. The first collection features characters introduced at the beginning of the Hunter Exam arc and the TV-size opening theme.

Character Song Collection 2 The Character Song Collection 2 is a collection of songs sung by voice actors of the "Hunter × Hunter" 2011 anime. The second collection features characters introduced in the Hunter Exam arc as well as the TV-size opening theme.

Cheadle Yorkshire Cheadle Yorkshire (チードル゠ヨークシャー, "Chīdoru Yōkushā") is a Triple-Star Disease Hunter and a member of the Zodiacs with the codename "" (, "Inu"). She is the 14th and current Chairwoman of Hunter Association, as well as a member of the Science Team created in preparation for the expedition to the Dark Continent. Appearance. <tabber> </tabber> Cheadle is a bespectacled woman of average height with sea-foam green hair cut, at medium length. She wears a headdress that has a pair of dog-like ears, a conservative, knee-length white dress and a white caplet with a cross at the front of the neck. Her upper jaw and nose also look like those of a dog. During the voyage to the Dark Continent, she acts as the chief doctor in which she wears a medical uniform, her hair is also cut shorter. Personality. Cheadle is shown to be a calm and intellectual person, with a well-defined moral compass. She seems to be more intelligent than most of the Zodiacs as even Pariston admits that his procedural skills are inferior to hers, although it is unknown if he says so honestly. She is very practical-minded and generally collected, although, she snaps at Ging, whose intelligence she admires, from time to time, mainly because of his carefree attitude. She is fiercely loyal to Isaac Netero and loathes Pariston. She apparently has a mild dislike for Saiyu due to his rudeness. At times, when she speaks, she specifies the person she is addressing at the end of her sentence. She is shown to be sensitive as she recognizes Leorio's quality and potential to be a good chairman of the Hunter Association and the reason why Ging doesn't avoid his Nen punch in the first place. Background. Cheadle is the figurehead of the pro-Netero faction in the Hunter Association. Plot. 13th Hunter Chairman Election arc. After Netero's death, complying with his will, Cheadle and the other Zodiacs gather to decide the structure for the election of a new Hunter Chairman. She tells Botobai and Kanzai that Netero chose Morel and Knov instead of any of them because he wanted to hunt by himself, and corrects Kanzai's grammar. When Pariston arrives, he takes the lead, offering to hand the reins over to Cheadle and Botobai, who refuse. When the Vice-Chairman proposes they skip the election and make him Chairman, Cheadle becomes hostile towards him. Ging's candidacy leaves her unsatisfied as well. To decide on an election method, she proposes to draw lots, ignoring Saiyu's objections, and tries to devise a system that would hamper Pariston's schemes. Beans is called to draw and picks Ging's sheet, which makes all Hunters candidates and voters, to the Zodiacs' collective annoyance. Cheadle is taken aback by Ging's self-appointment as Chief Executive of the Election Task Force, and even more by Ging's nonchalance when Pariston rejects it. She comes in second in the first and second rounds of the 13th Hunter Chairman Election, after which the Zodiacs have an assembly to decide how to address the issue of absentees and invalid votes. When Pariston suggests confiscating their Hunter License, Cheadle covertly calls him out on his plan to suspend their status as Hunters and deprive them of voting privileges. To herself, she wishes that Ging were present, what with Pariston being an uncontrollable monster, and wonder why Netero appointed him as Vice Chairman. However, in the third round, in which Cheadle keeps her place, abstentions have increased. When Pariston comes up with the idea of a speech to the whole association, Cheadle silently reaffirms her hatred for him and for how he reminds her of Netero. She attends the assembly, after which she places second again. Since, not in small part due to Leorio punching Ging, the quorum is finally reached, Cheadle, becomes one of the only 16 eligible candidates. In the fifth round, she is pushed in third place by Teradein, which she retains until the seventh round. Beans informs her Ging wants to leave and she chases after him to seek his advice on how to defeat Pariston. She lashes out at him several times, especially when he demonstrates her morals make her easy to read and claims that Pariston is the only one who is carrying the late Chairman's spirit. Since he anticipates she will refuse his suggestions, he limits himself to telling her Pariston's plan, which consists of delaying the end of the election until the "Day of Reckoning": the next Hunter Exam. He reveals that the Vice-Chairman secretly ordered 100 airships to transport about 5,000 hybrid Chimera Ant cocoons ready to hatch from the Royal Palace of East Gorteau to the territory of the former NGL so he can use them for his entertainment. Ging then leaves Cheadle to figure out what Pariston intends to do with them, suggesting she looks at the Hunter Bylaws for clues. As one of the four finalists, she attends the final assembly of Hunters, during which first Botobai, who recently dropped out of the race, then Mizaistom give her their support. With a surprising maneuver, when her turn to speak comes she recommends Leorio as the next Chairman. While she listens to his speech, she realizes why Ging let himself be hit by him and thinks she will be able to mold him into a good Chairman. She predicts Pariston will lose. To everyone's astonishment, Pariston announces he believes the most suitable candidate to be Mizaistom. Cheadle tries to figure out how he is planning to manipulate the votes with his speech. In the next round she comes in last and is removed from the top two. She is briefly shocked by Nanika's aura. Pariston wants to have another Q&A session with Leorio, which Cheadle regards as a pointless tactic. The Vice-Chairman makes an emergency motion to revise the Hunter Bylaws and the Hunter Exam, which, unlike Kanzai, Cheadle is favorable to. Thinking Pariston wants to hog Teradein's votes, Cheadle declares she will be Leorio's advisor on those matters. When Morel brings in a fully healed Gon, Cheadle understands Pariston won. She asks him when he knew things would turn out that way. To her disbelief, he responds he had pictured a similar scene from the moment Ging said Gon would not die, and that if the Boar, his worthy enemy, trusted Gon's friends to succeed, then he could trust them as well. Cheadle plans to use Gon's emotional entrance to sway the votes in Leorio's favor, but Pariston foils her plan by asking him who he'd vote for, to which he responds he'd vote for him since Leorio is studying to become a doctor. Pariston is elected Chairman, but, after nominating Cheadle his Vice-Chairman, immediately steps down. Furious, she chases him when he leaves the room, and is dumbfounded to see him cry about Netero's death. Pariston warns her not to make a boring Hunter Association, or he will really "make fun" of her. Dark Continent Expedition arc. Cheadle is appointed Chairman in the ensuing election. After the Zodiacs watch a video in which Nasubi Hui Guo Rou, ruler of the Kakin Empire, announces an expedition to the Dark Continent led by Netero's son Beyond Netero, and that the late Chairman left a DVD with instructions for a similar eventuality, Cheadle announces that she approved Pariston's and Ging's requests to withdraw from the Zodiacs and that the V5 commissioned the Hunter Association to hunt down Beyond. The Zodiacs watch Netero's DVD, who requests them to organize a more successful expedition to the Dark Continent than his son's. While they discuss their plan of action, they receive a call from Beyond Netero himself. The Zodiacs meet up with him in person and Beyond hands himself over, instructing them to contact the V5 to negotiate with them. Beyond is locked in a cell and Cheadle records her conversation with him. He claims he will be released and the Hunter Association will go to the Dark Continent with him, which Cheadle finds impossible. To herself, she thinks he resembles Netero profoundly. Realizing theirs is a battle, Cheadle reconsiders her initial intention to involve only the Zodiacs. She has Mizaistom call the V5 after announcing the entire Hunter Association will go to the Dark Continent. Cheadle phones Leorio and offers him a place in the Zodiacs, as following the events of the election he is the most respected Hunter. She explains that at her request, his university approved an indefinite term for study abroad if he accepts, warning him of the dangers and the difficulty. He accepts and advances another nomination for the Zodiacs. Cheadle thus sends Mizaistom to fetch Kurapika. That night, the IPA Director tells her to write up a contract for Beyond and promises there will be severe repercussions if Beyond claims any discoveries as his own. She brings the contract to Beyond, which details the limitations to his freedom and his duties towards the Hunter Association and the V5. After signing it, he tells her they have gained "permission", but they still need "qualifications", "means", and a "contract". Cheadle is later seen greeting Leorio and Kurapika and introduces them to the rest of the Zodiacs. She starts explaining about the V6, the Five Threats, and their plan to take Beyond only as far as the New Continent. She adjoins the difficulty of the mission is A, whereas the Chimera Ants were ranked B, and asks if anyone has any questions. Kurapika raises his hand, saying he has many. The first is how many infiltrators on Netero's side the Zodiacs have managed to identify, much to everyone's shock. After Mizaistom escorts him out, she resumes her speech, informing everyone she has been searching for expert medicians to travel to the Dark Continent safely. She is assigned to the Science Team. Then, she explains that changes to the Hunter Exam were made so that they can select the very best applicants to have them join the expedition, and invites the Zodiacs to cooperate and do their best. Cheadle is the proctor for the last trial of the 289th Hunter Exam. She asks the candidates: first, if they were aware of Nasubi's project before it was made public; second, through what means; third, what are the economical, cultural and social merits previous knowledge would grant. After Kurapika scrutinizes all the applicants, Mizaistom summons the Zodiacs, minus Kurapika and Leorio. He and Cheadle trade glances and she understands he is going to reveal the possibility of a mole among them, although she is dubious. Like the others, she describes her abilities, apparently unaware that Kurapika is spying them through a surveillance camera to determine the liar with his dowsing. Succession Contest arc. Some time after the meeting is concluded, Cheadle rushes to Mizaistom to inform him that the Kakin princes are recruiting bodyguards: this might mean that some of the infiltrators that they rejected during the Hunter Exam might still be able to board the ship. There is a total of six requests. Cheadle later boards the ship to the Dark Continent. She directs the center medical care facility on Tier 3. Cheadle is shown to be in the Medical Ward in Tier 3 with Gel and Leorio. Abilities & Powers. As the Chairman of the Hunter Association, Cheadle has the highest authority among all Hunters, as well as access to all the annexed privileges. Her combat and Nen abilities have yet to be revealed but since, as a Zodiac, she used to be Netero's sparring partner, and she was believed by Kanzai to be stronger than Morel and Knov, she must be a competent and most likely powerful Nen user, in spite of Pariston's claim that she lacks the necessary strength to be Chairman, which she was sure he himself did not believe. According to Pariston, Cheadle has the best leadership skills in the Zodiacs. Being also a law scholar and a doctor, it can be inferred that Cheadle is knowledgeable in jurisprudence and medicine. Her status as a Triple-Star Disease Hunter indicates that she has made discoveries of utmost importance in the latter field. Preternatural Perception: Unlike Leorio, she was capable of sensing Nanika's aura when it healed Gon. Genius-Level Intellect: Cheadle is smart, knowledgeable and practical-minded, traits that earned her the moniker of "Brains of the Zodiacs". Despite being usually able to keep her cool, at times she would, especially when Ging and Pariston are involved lose her temper. Although they are capable of more accurate predictions, she is still a master at calculating her opponent's future moves and the trend of the election making her a proficient tactician. Nen. As a Hunter, she is capable of utilizing Nen.

Cheetu Cheetu (ヂートゥ, "Jītu") was a cheetah-based Chimera Ant and the fastest Squadron Leader. Appearance. Cheetu's appearance resembled that of a humanoid cheetah, he was also rather tall and slender. His arms and legs were built in a segmented fashion, similar to many other second-generation Chimera Ants. His chest and thighs were covered in white fur and his head was covered with neck long purple hair. Beneath his eyes were two purple lines, similar to those of a cheetah's. He also bore a feline muzzle. Cheetu's only clothing was a pair of cut-off blue shorts. Personality. Cheetu was very simple-minded, confident, and arrogant. He was commonly very impressed with his own speed. Unlike some other Chimera Ants, Cheetu had no greater plans and was simply content with being the fastest among the other Chimera Ants. Cheetu also enjoyed fighting only to boast and show off his abilities. In a confrontation against a group of police officers, Cheetu waited until the last possible moment to dodge a barrage of bullets fired at him, then dismembered the fingers of all his attackers, before asking them to "bring some faster guys tomorrow." After learning and being initiated into Nen, Cheetu showed a creative side, always trying to create new abilities, although they were not always efficient. He developed a rivalry with Morel after their first fight, with the latter openly declaring that he could win against him only because of Cheetu's stupidity. Plot. Chimera Ant arc. After talking to Zazan, Cheetu informs Colt that their peons are getting killed with mysterious weapons. Later, Peggy and Colt confront Cheetu and Hagya about their hobby of killing humans. Cheetu states that their units meet their quotas, and hunt only in their free time, although he implies he does not keep an exact count. Cheetu is initiated to Nen by Rammot along with the other Squadron Leaders as per Neferpitou's orders. He is among the Squadron Leaders present when Meruem is born. With the Queen on the brink of death, he wonders what they should do. Hagya points out that it does not matter if she survives, as she has lost the ability to breed, and Cheetu convenes with him. He thus leaves the nest to become the "Speed King" and devours the humans at the NGL Border Stop. He ventures East and outside of the country, crossing into the Republic of Rokario, where he finds a city that he excitedly calls a feeding ground. He begins to rampage in Pata City and, when the police arrive, he easily dodges their bullets and tears off their fingers, commenting they are too slow and clumsy to be a challenge. He then declares he will be back the following day and demands they bring someone faster before running towards the Miera Mountains. While running on a desert road, he sees a man standing in front of a smokescreen. Knuckle tries to punch him, but Cheetu avoids his attack as well as Morel's. He hits the two Hunters with a barrage of punches, claiming they are slightly better than his opponents from the day before and that they will die without a chance to strike back. Knuckle retorts that Cheetu's punches are too weak, which causes the Chimera Ant to laugh and conclude he is too proud to admit defeat. He strikes them again and is amused by Knuckle's attempt to punch him. He picks up his speed, but notices that, even though they are still too slow, his opponents are managing to follow him with their eyes and aim at him. Beginning to enjoy the fight, he pummels them again. He claims their efforts are useless, as their bodies cannot keep up with their reactions, and then asks them how they are planning to defeat him. Knuckle responds they will use wits and experience, and the smoke surrounds the three. Since they are also standing in it, Cheetu realizes it is not poisonous but a simple smokescreen. However, he freezes up for a moment when multiple copies of Knuckle jump at him, which the original exploits to punch him. Cheetu comments the blow did not hurt at all, but is puzzled to see A.P.R. appear. He demands that Knuckle tell him what it is, but the Hunter disappears in the smoke. Before he can reach him, Morel trips Cheetu and goes into hiding too. The smoke dissipates and Cheetu finds himself alone. He dashes away, determined to lose A.P.R.. However, he soon realizes he cannot outrun it. Panting under a tree, he resolves to learn more about Nen and to obtain a power greater than pure speed. The Hunter Association sends a Hunter after him, but Cheetu manages to escape. The following morning, he manages to avoid being ambushed by Knuckle and Shoot thanks to Flutter timely warning him. He then meets up with Hagya, now going by the name of Leol, who offers to remove A.P.R. in exchange for his help with a mission given to him by the Royal Guards. Hearing the target is a Hunter, Cheetu notes they are difficult to deal with. Leol tells him to head to the palace, where Shaiapouf will prepare a Nen ability for him in exchange for his loyalty. Cheetu says he is in Leol's debt and comments that he keeps taking the best spots. Leol replies he used to be the king of animals, which prompts Cheetu to think he is obviously trying to recapture the crown. When he reaches the palace, Hina removes A.P.R. from him and Shaiapouf bestows a Nen ability on him. He confronts Morel again while the latter was keeping Peijin under watch, and using his new power, Cheetu transports both of them to a place conjured by him which is isolated from the real world. He informs the Hunter he has 8 hours to catch him. Instead of chasing him, however, Morel begins to explore his surroundings and tries to break the hourglass. When this fails, he resolves to rest for 5 hours, much to Cheetu's irritation. The Chimera Ant decides to provoke him until he gives chase. However, around the four-hour mark he gets bored and starts reading a book. Morel stands up, claiming it is over, and Cheetu sees a rope made out of smoke connecting his ankle to the Hunter's pipe. He tries to run away and break the rope, in vain, while Morel reels it in. Cornered, Cheetu creates a new ability, conjuring a crossbow and a set of claws. He shoots at Morel, who easily blocks the bolt with his pipe, stating how it is useless for Cheetu to have a weapon slower than his own legs and that Cheetu will lose due to his stupidity. Enraged, Cheetu rushes at him and stabs him with the claws, but his opponent turns out to be a smoke clone. The real Morel appears behind him and touches his shoulder, sending both of them back to Peijin. Due to the conditions of his ability, Cheetu becomes unable to ever use it again, this does not bother him however as he simply returns to the palace to get another from Shaiapouf, itching to fight Morel again. He emerges from the cocoon with a new power before the Extermination Team raids the palace. That night, Cheetu survives Dragon Dive unscathed and comes upon "Ikalgo disguised as Flutter" and Bloster. He heads off to test his new ability. He goes looking for Morel, but is unable to enter Smoky Jail. After spotting Zeno, he follows him outside of the palace and insists on fighting him. Seeing the assassin's annoyance, he comments Zeno was not his opponent of choice either. The assassin realizes talking will do nothing and tells Cheetu to look behind himself. Cheetu jeers at him instantly before being crushed to death by Silva from above. Abilities & Powers. As a Chimera Ant, Cheetu is stronger than any normal human. His status as a Squadron Leader proves he is even more powerful than that. During his time as a Squadron Leader, he had authority over his underlings, although it is unclear how much influence he retained after the death of the Queen. He fights and hunts by using his speed. Whether he catches his prey unawares or not is irrelevant: even pro Hunters have a hard time adapting to his quickness. He would be infinitely more dangerous if not for his many weak spots, all of which came down to his foolishness: Cheetu is so proud of his speed he feels no need to make plans or focus on his opponents; moreover, he has near to no analytical skills and does not pay any attention to his surroundings. He also seems unable to gauge the power of his foe. Enhanced Strength: Cheetu can chop off fingers and bite through a human skull while running so fast that normal humans cannot perceive him. When he stopped holding back, multiple punches from him were able to draw blood from Knuckle and Morel. Enhanced Durability: His body is considerably durable, since a punch from a Nen-using Rammot did not leave him with any permanent or visible injury. Unfathomable Speed and Reflexes: Cheetu's primary trait is his great speed, which allows him to dodge bullets with ease after they touch the lock of hair on his forehead, and punch two experienced Hunters several times without their bodies being able to react to his top speed, although they managed to follow him with their eyes about one minute into the fight. He can reach a speed of 200 km/h or even higher in an instant, and one between 150 and 180 km/h appears to be a casual travel speed for him. His reactions are so quick that Knuckle and Morel's movements seemed to him to slow down to a near standstill, enabling him to calmly comment on their speed while avoiding their attacks and retaliating; however, shock and strong emotions have proven to impair his ability to dodge. Enhanced Stamina: Cheetu can run at immense speeds for long periods of time without growing tired, although it seems that maintaining what is a fast pace by his own standard wears him out rather quickly. Hand-to-Hand Combatant: He has displayed decent hand-to-hand combat skills, which, coupled with his speed, allowed him to take on Knuckle and Morel simultaneously. Except when he feeds, his fighting style seems to be based exclusively on quick jabs which he throws in quick succession, aiming at the head when he is serious and also at the trunk when he plays around. Nen. . Unlike some self-taught Chimera Ants like Zazan and Rammot, he needed Shaiapouf's help to control his Nen and invent a Nen ability, with the notable exception he unconsciously used Gyo in his fight against Morel and Knuckle. Tag is one of the attacks that Cheetu has. It allows Cheetu to transport his opponents to an alternate realm where they play a game of tag with the time limit of 8 hours, Cheetu can conjure a miniature crossbow with a clawed end to attack his opponents with (the crossbow itself is much slower than Cheetu, however).

Cherry Cherry (チェリー, "Cherī") was examinee #76 in the 287th Hunter Exam and a martial arts expert. Appearance. Cherry was a man of average height, had a flat top cut and ponytail, piercing eyes, and a droopy nose. He wore a type of martial arts style clothing and shoes. Personality. Cherry although when put into a serious life-threatening situation like facing Hisoka, had a stoic demeanor and obviously knew when he's outmatched by someone of a higher caliber. Plot. Hunter Exam arc. Tonpa introduces Cherry as a veteran for taking the Hunter Exam and is a martial artist who specializes in unarmed combat. Amid the first phase of the Hunter Exam, he runs next to examinee #255 Todo and notes that so far out of the six hours that have passed only one examinee (#187 Nicholas) has dropped out and must stay on his toes. Before long, he sees a giant stairway at the end of the tunnel and must climb it to the top. During the First Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam, Cherry, Leorio, and Kurapika were the only three left of a group of candidates after Hisoka indiscriminately attacked them to eliminate those he deemed unworthy. Realizing that they had no chance they ran away in 3 different directions. However this didn't help Cherry as later his corpse was seen hanging upside down on a tree with a card stuck in his forehead, implying that Hisoka killed him.

Chibaba Chibaba (チパパ, "Chipapa") is a prizefighter in the Heavens Arena. Appearance. Chibaba has fair, spiky hair that is combed backward and narrow eyes. He wears a black shirt. Plot. Heavens Arena arc. Chibaba makes a brief appearance on the 50th floor when he is scheduled to fight against Maita. They're weak in Killua's opinion.

Chief of Wolf Pack (G.I card) Chief of Wolf Pack (, "Gunrō no Osa"—or "Alpha Wolf" in the Viz translation) is a card found in the Greed Island game. This is a standard card that can be obtained by the player. These cards can be placed in the player's "Free Slots". This is the chief of a Wolf Pack. Summary. The Wolf Pack are a bunch of wolf that can walk and fight upright and have decent combat ability. This is the chief of a pack of wolves.
