Chrollo explains that he stole the ability from a girl who had predicted that they would attack the auction. After Chrollo adds that even several of the Dons are her patrons, Franklin says that everything makes sense as Shizuku wonders what Nobunaga's fortune was. Chrollo says that he doesn't know since his hand wrote it on its own, telling them to ask Nobunaga. He also explains that they are poems with four or five sections that correspond to each week of the month. Shalnark speaks up and asks him what it said, and Nobunaga reveals that five of the Spiders will die the following week. Franklin asks which of them, and Nobunaga replies that he doesn't know, saying that he can only understand the second section about the Spider being cut in half since including Uvogin would make six. As Shizuku and Franklin look over the fortune, Chrollo tells them that his said the same thing and guesses that their fortunes will also be similar. After Shizuku asks for her fortune and Chrollo writes it out, Shizuku learns that she will be among the dead half, noting that she only has sections for the first two weeks. She adds that Pakunoda and Shalnark will also die, but wonders who "Scarlet Eyes" is. After Nobunaga asks her how she figured it out, Shizuku explains that since the frost moon is November and it's the eleventh month, it's referring to Uvogin who was No. 11 among the Troupe. She says that the other names are months as well, and Chrollo adds that the harvest moon is September, the wine moon August, and the lovers' moon June. He also notes that several of the words such as "barren" and "slumber" are used to represent death. Phinks is confident that "Scarlet Eyes" doesn't refer to any of them, guessing that it's the chain user. Pakunoda remembers what the term means, and Feitan says that one of them must have survived. The member covered in bandages asks if the chain user will also die, but Phinks replies that just "bloody" is too vague. Shalnark speaks up and stresses to Nobunaga that it's not worth losing so many of their members just to go after the chain user. He adds that while Nobunaga's and his own ability are replaceable, they can't afford to lose Shizuku and Pakunoda's since they're rare. Chrollo says that it's the first Saturday in September and that it would be unlikely for them to encounter the chain user next week if they went home immediately. He comments on how useful the fortunes are and says that if they leave without fighting, the poems won't come true. He reminds Nobunaga that he and Uvogin agreed to risk their lives for the rest of the group, adding that Shizuku, Pakunoda, and Shalnark are vital to the Troupe for their recon and cleanup and that it's his job to protect them. He wonders which of them is truly being selfish and asks if he has anything else to say, with Nobunaga replying that he doesn't. As storm clouds gather outside, Killua stresses to Kurapika that they have to act quickly before the remaining members leave the group's hideout. Kurapika recognizes that the memory reader could be a threat, but says that he has to move on now that their leader is dead, agreeing with Gon that he should focus on recovering the eyes of his people. However, Hisoka suddenly sends Kurapika a text message saying that the corpses are fake, leaving Kurapika stunned as rain begins to fall outside.

Chapter 105 September 4th: Part 4 (94④, "Kugatsu Yokka (Yon)") is the 105th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As the pouring rain continues outside, Leorio runs after Kurapika and asks him what's wrong, with Killua wondering if the call was from Hisoka. Kurapika replies that it was and that he said the Phantom Troupe's corpses are fake, guessing that one of them has the ability to create copies. Killua likens it to the person at Heavens Arena, and Gon remembers that Kastro was able to create a double. Kurapika comments on how serious the situation is and scolds himself for not realizing sooner that a Conjurer could have such an ability. Kurapika stops and appears nervous, with Killua asking what's wrong and assuring him that they will do anything to help. Kurapika's phone suddenly rings with a call from Melody, who reveals that the Mafia has ended their search for the remaining Troupe members after they discovered that they are from Meteor City. As Neon is seen looking at the Scarlet Eyes, Melody adds that the Dons themselves gave the order for the search to end. Killua asks if it was Hisoka calling again, but Kurapika replies that it was someone from his work, revealing what Melody told him and saying that the reward money was also canceled. After Kurapika explains the situation, Gon wonders about Meteor City, and Leorio says that the people who live there don't officially exist. He explains that it started out as an internment camp created by a dictator and that now no country wants to interfere with it, adding that it's the most diverse place on earth. As Leorio reveals that around ten million people survive off the waste that's left behind, which includes gold and weapons given to the city by a certain organization, Kurapika points out that that organization is the Mafia. Gon and Killua are left confused, but Leorio explains that it's the perfect place to recruit since the people there have no official records. He says that the two had the perfect partnership until the Troupe ruined it, adding that even the Troupe is special in such a unique place. It's stated that Pakunoda is a Specialist whose ability allows her to read memories by touching people and objects. It's added that she can also implant memories in others by firing conjured bullets loaded with them, but if a bullet loaded with someone's memories hits that same person, they will lose them. At the Troupe's hideout, Chrollo agrees to write out everyone's fortunes since it may help them to avoid danger, telling the other members to write down their name, birthday, and blood type. Since Feitan doesn't know his birthday, and Phinks has no idea about his blood type, they are both unable to have their fortunes told. The others read their fortunes, and as Hisoka reads through his own, Pakunoda asks what it says and tells him to let her see it. A wary Hisoka replies that he doesn't think it's a good idea since she wouldn't like it, but Pakunoda again tells him to let her see it. Hisoka hands over the piece of paper, and Pakunoda seems stunned as she reads it, with Chrollo looking on and Hisoka readying his deck of cards.

Chapter 106 September 4th: Part 5 (94⑤, "Kugatsu Yokka (Go)") is the 106th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. After Pakunoda reads through Hisoka's fortune, she tosses the paper to Franklin and tells the others to look at it. Unknown to the rest of the Phantom Troupe as they try to make sense of the mention of a red-eyed customer and the moons' secrets, the fortune is different from the one that Hisoka initially read. Once an impatient Nobunaga reads through the fortune, he unsheathes his katana and asks Hisoka if he betrayed Uvogin. Hisoka continues to look through his deck of cards, but when Nobunaga takes it as confirmation and tries to confront him, Franklin and Shalnark block his path. Franklin tries to calm him down by reminding him that Chrollo said the fortunes can be avoided. He asks about the current week, but Hisoka replies that he can't tell them, only revealing that the first section is accurate. As Nobunaga remains upset, Shalnark asks Hisoka why he can't tell them, and Hisoka replies that he can't say anything more, readying his deck of cards as a weapon and saying that he will defend himself if they don't accept his answer. Sheathing his katana and appearing to be done with the argument, Nobunaga suddenly dashes toward Hisoka and prepares to strike, but he suddenly disappears and is left standing off to the side. Nobunaga first thinks that Hisoka teleported, but then realizes that he was the one who was moved. As his aura swells around him, Chrollo tells Nobunaga to be quiet as Phinks asks Machi if Chrollo was behind that. Guessing that he was, Machi replies that she doesn't know what ability it was. Chrollo addresses Hisoka and says that he doesn't have to answer his question if he can't, first asking what secrets the chain user stole. Hisoka's answer is people's abilities, and Chrollo then asks how many he stole, with Hisoka first saying seven but quickly correcting himself to eight, listing out Chrollo, Uvogin, Shizuku, Machi, Franklin, Pakunoda, Shalnark, and himself. Chrollo asks about the chain user's ability, but Hisoka replies that he can't say. Chrollo then asks about his appearance and Hisoka's relationship to him, but Hisoka again says that he can't answer. After Hisoka confirms that he just learned about Kortopi's ability yesterday, Chrollo surmises that the chain user has at least two abilities: one that was used to capture Uvogin and the other that is restricting what Hisoka can do. He cites the words "sword of law" from his fortune and guesses that Hisoka is being forced to obey a set of rules after something was planted inside him by the enemy. As the other members listen in stunned silence, Chrollo continues to analyze the fortune and says that Hisoka was forced to betray them because of the "sword of law" attack. Hisoka becomes aroused by Chrollo's intellect and tells himself that he will enjoy killing him. Chrollo tells the others that the sword may be conjured or manipulated, confident that the ability is extremely powerful. Shalnark gives a summary of the situation by first saying that their enemy uses chains and is either a Manipulator with real chains or a Conjurer with Nen chains. Shizuku wonders if there's a difference, and Shalnark stresses that a Conjurer would have a big advantage by appearing to be empty-handed. He adds that a Manipulator would need to have his weapon at all times, and Shizuku remembers that Conjurers can eventually make their weapon appear at will after they have done enough image training. Phinks wonders if conjured chains would have worked against Uvogin, and Shalnark confirms this by explaining that the user could paralyze the target or put them to sleep. However, he turns their attention back to the ability that is restricting Hisoka, and Phinks asks if the sword of law would force him to keep a promise. Shalnark guesses that Hisoka would die if he broke the promise to follow the chain user's orders. The situation is then explained in detail: there is no sword of law in Hisoka's body because Hisoka used his Texture Surprise to mask the real fortune with a fake one he created on the spot. Hisoka was telling the truth about revealing the Troupe's abilities to Kurapika, but he had only revealed Uvogin and Shizuku's. He doesn't know the others' abilities well enough, only knowing for example that Pakunoda is a Specialist who can read memories by touching her target and fire conjured bullets called Memory Bombs (with only her and Chrollo knowing about them). The other Spiders have similar hidden abilities that they make sure to keep secret since they are vital to their survival, with Hisoka also having one involving his Texture Surprise. Machi is the only member aware of the ability and believes that Hisoka uses it on his body, but Hisoka can recreate over one thousand textures on any flat surface. This allowed him to recreate the same texture and ink that Chrollo used for his fortune. It's then mentioned that Hisoka's gamble only worked out because Chrollo picked up on the clues left in the fake fortune. It's finally stated that since Hisoka's obsession takes priority over everything, he risked it all to keep the Troupe in Yorknew just so he would have the chance to fight Chrollo. Hisoka tells the others that he plans to stay at the hideout since there are things he wants to do before he dies. Chrollo says that Hisoka, Shizuku, Pakunoda, Shalnark, and one more member (in addition to Uvogin) completes the half that are fated to die, guessing that the last one is either himself, Feitan, or Kortopi. Phinks says that they weren't able to answer the required questions to have their fortunes told, and Franklin adds that they were lucky to get as many as they did considering their backgrounds. As Shalnark asks Chrollo what they should do and Chrollo decides that they should stay, Milluki is seen carrying an umbrella in the city and wondering what he should eat.

Chapter 107 September 4th: Part 6 (94⑥, "Kugatsu Yokka (Roku)") is the 107th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Killua says that it's time for them to stop, but Gon asks why since he was so eager before. Killua explains that it would be pointless to risk their lives since there's no longer any reward money for capturing the Phantom Troupe. Even though he acknowledges his point, Gon replies that it's not pointless to capture them, but Killua reminds him that his goal is to acquire a copy of Greed Island, pointing out that they should be raising money for the auction that starts the day after tomorrow. Gon reveals that he has an idea about the game, but when Killua asks him about it, he refuses to say just yet, causing Killua to put him in a playful chokehold. Gon says that he will handle the game while they chase after the Troupe for a little longer. Killua asks for the probability of his plan succeeding, and Gon initially says 70% before changing it to 60%. Killua guesses that it's actually closer to a 50/50 split, but says that it probably has a better chance than trying to make 6 billion in two days. Killua agrees to let Gon handle the game, but tells him that they need Kurapika's help in capturing the Troupe. Kurapika tells Leorio that he asked about the auction, but that the Mafia hasn't made any decisions yet. Leorio says that they might reconsider if he tells them that the Spiders are still alive, but Kurapika is confident that the Mafia doesn't want to have any disagreements with Meteor City, guessing that the organization's war against the Troupe is finished. He wonders if the auction will still be held, and Leorio realizes that Kurapika plans to fight the Troupe, wondering how he will do it without the Mafia's help. As Kurapika corrects Leorio by saying that he isn't counting on their help, Gon and Killua meet up with the two of them, with Gon assuring Kurapika that they will do anything to help him and Killua silently hoping that he will refuse the offer. Although Kurapika reminds him that the reward was canceled, Gon says that he hasn't changed his mind about wanting to stop the Troupe. Kurapika thinks about it and says that he would be risking his life, with Killua saying to himself that it will only make Gon want to do it more. Gon remains resolute, and Kurapika says that they should all sit down and discuss it. He first says that one of them needs to watch the Troupe's hideout and relay information, with Killua quickly volunteering for the job. Kurapika tells him that they only need to focus on Pakunoda and that he can ignore the others. He tells him to be careful, and Killua assures him that he won't take any unnecessary risks. Kurapika asks Leorio to be his driver, and Leorio reluctantly agrees, assuring them that he's not scared after Killua points out that he will be safe with Kurapika. Kurapika tells Gon that his job is to create a diversion, but Killua worries about the risk and says that he would have to confront them again. Kurapika explains that he will capture Pakunoda and move her by car while Gon diverts the Troupe's attention, asking that he try to keep them busy for one second. Gon remembers how quickly Machi was able to restrain him and asks himself if he can do it. Kurapika tells him that he is vital to their plan, and Gon says that he will think about it. Kurapika says that the Troupe will take action in the next six hours if the auction is still held, considering the possibility that they are already on the move. Killua says to himself that he should try to buy some time and asks Kurapika aloud why he decided to let them help. Kurapika replies that the situation is more dangerous and that he needs to deal with Pakunoda regardless of the risk. Leorio says to himself that Kurapika didn't need to tell them about his abilities, realizing that he's seeing how ruthless he can be and adding that they need to be careful. With a serious expression on his face, Gon suddenly asks Kurapika if he can use his Nen dagger on him as well.

Chapter 108 September 4th: Part 7 (94⑦, "Kugatsu Yokka (Nana)") is the 108th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. The others sit in silence after Gon asks Kurapika to use his Nen dagger on him, but Leorio speaks up and reminds Gon that Kurapika will die if he attacks anyone other than a Phantom Troupe member. However, Gon then asks why Kurapika has a Nen dagger in his own heart, causing Leorio and Killua to wonder too before turning to look at Kurapika. He says that the answer will increase the risk, and Leorio stands up and tells Killua that they should leave. Kurapika tells Gon that he can use the dagger on him, explaining that each of his five chains has a different use and that he uses two of them against the Troupe. He first shows Chain Jail on his middle finger, saying that it restrains his target and forces them into Zetsu. He then shows the Judgment Chain on his pinky finger, saying that he stabs his target's heart with the dagger and sets a rule that causes them to die if they break it. He reveals that after planning to use it on himself with the rule that he could never attack anyone with his chains other than a Troupe member, he worried that using the chain on himself might be considered breaking the rule, not wanting to take the chance that he would be an exception even though he would set the rule after stabbing himself. He explains that he amended the rule to only state that he would never use Chain Jail on anyone other than the Troupe, allowing him to use his Judgment Chain freely. However, as Kurapika's eyes begin to turn scarlet and draw Gon's attention, he explains that he can only use the ability once his eyes are that color. Gon asks if he can turn it on by himself, and Kurapika says that while it takes time, he is able to do it now. He explains that it was necessary because he is a Conjurer and using the dagger and forcing rules involve Manipulation and Emission. He then reveals to Gon that he becomes a Specialist when his eyes turn scarlet and that he can use any abilities he has learned to their full effect. It's stated that Nen abilities come in six types which determine the user's strengths and weaknesses. It's explained that if Kurapika had 100% mastery of Conjuration (a "level 10" Conjurer), the highest level of mastery he could attain in Transmutation would be 80%, 60% in Enhancement and Manipulation, and 40% in Emission, with him acquiring less strength in the types that are further from his own. An example is given showing that if Kurapika (as a level 10 Conjurer) and an Emitter (at level 4) used the same emissive ability simultaneously, the Emitter would be more effective because it's his Nen type. However, it's explained that if Kurapika's eyes turned scarlet, he could then use the level 4 emissive ability at 100%, allowing him to equal the effectiveness of the level 4 Emitter. As Gon says to himself that the explanation went over his head, he tells Kurapika to use his dagger on him and create a rule. Kurapika thanks him for his dedication and readies his ability, but Leorio and Killua suddenly appear behind him, both volunteering to be stabbed as well. However, Kurapika says that he doesn't plan to use his Judgment Chain on any of them, leaving all three surprised. Gon worries about Pakunoda catching him again, but Kurapika points out that he would be killing himself prematurely if a rule was created about not letting Pakunoda touch him at all. He explains that she may not read her target's memories right when she touches them and that they could deal with her before she is able to tell the others. Gon then asks Kurapika why he's telling them so much about his ability if it increases the risk, and Kurapika replies that he just wanted to thank them for their dedication, assuring them that he won't regret revealing his secret if the Troupe learns it from them and telling himself that he has been blessed with good friends. Gon says that he feels more pressure about disappointing a friend than risking his own life, causing both of them to laugh. Killua remains concerned and leaves to start his reconnaissance mission, taking out his Beatle-07 phone and telling himself that he has more motivation now. At the Troupe's hideout, Shizuku, Pakunoda, Shalnark, and Hisoka all read their fortunes as Chrollo tells them that they will split up into teams, stressing that they should avoid being alone for the next week. He splits the Troupe into four groups: Shizuku, Pakunoda, and Machi; Kortopi, Phinks, and Feitan (those who were unable to have their fortunes told because they didn't know the necessary information); Nobunaga, Shalnark, and himself; Bonolenov, Franklin, and Hisoka, who are to stay behind at the hideout. Machi tells Chrollo that there are kids who know about the hideout's location, worrying about them even though they don't seem connected to the chain user. Nobunaga excitedly remembers and tells Chrollo that he nominates them to be members. After Nobunaga tells him about them, Chrollo replies that while they sound interesting, it's unlikely that they would ever join the Troupe. Nobunaga assures him that he will talk them into joining and that he will bring them back so he can judge them for himself. Machi is ardently against Nobunaga's plan because of a hunch, and Chrollo says that her hunches are usually reliable, adding that they shouldn't ignore it. He decides that they should make more fake hideouts and asks Kortopi if he can make ten more, with Kortopi replying that he can make fifty. From a rooftop in the distance, Killua says that something is different and first thinks that he is at the wrong location, but quickly realizes that so many of the buildings appeared out of nowhere. Kortopi adds that he will know if anyone enters any of the fake buildings since his copies also act as his En.

Chapter 109 September 4th: Part 8 (94⑧, "Kugatsu Yokka (Hachi)") is the 109th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Killua sneaks down toward the Phantom Troupe's hideout and says that the street was wide open the previous day, realizing that the buildings really appeared out of nowhere. He's confident that it involves Nen and worries about falling into a trap. He then contacts Kurapika, who is seen wearing a disguise and tells him that it has to be the work of a Conjurer. Driving the car, Leorio says that he can't believe it's possible to conjure entire buildings. Kurapika tells Killua to be wary of traps, and Killua says that it proves the Troupe is still in the area. He adds that he can now only see 20% of the area from a distance, and Kurapika points out that he is more likely to encounter them if he wanders around. Killua worries about what he will do if he hears any of their voices, admitting that his heart is pounding. Kurapika lingers on the mention of voices and tells Killua to return to his post, adding that he will call back in five minutes. Kurapika then calls Melody and asks where she is. Melody answers that she's escorting Neon during her shopping spree, revealing that it's worse than being a bodyguard and that Basho is reaching his limit. Kurapika asks her to do something, and Melody agrees as Neon and her attendants move to another store. At the Troupe's hideout, Shalnark confirms to Chrollo that he has told them everything that Uvogin told him about the chain user. He says that they were searching for pictures of Nostrade Family employees on the Hunter Website, with Uvogin recognizing three of them. He adds that while Uvogin left to check out their hotels, he kept doing research and learned that the members were bodyguards for Nostrade's daughter. Chrollo says that it was the night of September 1 and that he checked the website yesterday, handing a picture of Neon to Phinks, who remembers that Chrollo met her and stole her ability. Chrollo also hands out a list of bodyguards and points out that two more were added, asking Shalnark to see if the list on the website has been updated again. Franklin is surprised that one girl would have so many guards, but Chrollo notes that her father only obtained his status through her ability. Shizuku wonders why she is in Yorknew, and Pakunoda guesses that she's there for the auction. Chrollo suddenly has a realization and calls himself stupid for not putting the pieces together to find the chain user sooner. He says that he looked up her ability and didn't think anything of the information at the time, but tells the others that she collects body parts as a hobby. After Shalnark makes the connection to the Scarlet Eyes, Chrollo says that the chain user wanted to be hired by the Nostrade Family because he knew that the eyes would be auctioned and that the girl wanted them. He adds that the chain user wants to get revenge on the Troupe and recover his people's eyes. He asks Shalnark if there were any Scarlet Eyes, but Shalnark apologizes and says that he doesn't know since he had the auctioneer on autopilot. However, Kortopi confirms that the eyes were there and that he made copies of them. Chrollo remembers that he said his copies act as his En and asks if he can locate them. Kortopi confirms that he can if he touches the originals. After the group searches through the auction items and Shizuku finds the eyes, Kortopi touches them and points to his right, saying that the copies are a mile and a half in that direction. As Nobunaga's aura swells around him, Kortopi says that they need to hurry since the copies will disappear in a few hours. After Phinks hands him a map, Chrollo says that the chain user is at the Hotel Beitacle. Nobunaga desperately asks Chrollo to let him go, and Chrollo says that he is coming with him, also telling him not to wander off by himself. After Nobunaga happily agrees to follow his orders, Chrollo tells Pakunoda, Machi and Shizuku to come with them as well, then asking Shalnark to switch teams with Kortopi. At the Hotel Beitacle, Squala sits reading a magazine as the eyes are seen on the table and several dogs sit all around him. He hears a knock at the door and asks who it is. The person answers that it's room service, and Squala tells him to leave it in the hall, adding that the tip is under the door. Squala then has one of the dogs unlock the door and push the cart of food inside. As he and the dogs eat together, he says that things are getting too difficult and he needs to find another job. He adds that Eliza also wants to quit and worries that not many jobs would feed all the dogs and satisfy Eliza, who is seen still shopping with Neon. Having moved back to a rooftop as the rain continues to fall, Killua is seen eating a few snacks when he suddenly gets a call from someone asking if it's him. Killua asks in return who they are, and Melody replies that they work with Kurapika, telling him to look to his left. As Killua sees her standing on a nearby rooftop, she tells him to hang up the phone and whisper something for her to do. Killua hangs up and whispers for her to raise her right hand, which Melody immediately does. Killua is left impressed and says that her hearing will definitely be useful as the six Troupe members are seen making their way through the rain toward the hotel.

Chapter 11 The Inevitable Outcome (の, "Tōzen no Kekka") is the 11th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Buhara continues to devour the roasted Great Stamps before eventually becoming full and leaving a tall stack of bones behind him. Menchi strikes a gong to mark the moment, and the examinees can't believe that Buhara was able to eat 70 roast pigs. Gon is impressed by how amazing Hunters are, and the other examinees are left confused by how Buhara ate more food than he can hold, with Leorio telling them not to think about it too much. Menchi can't believe that he just ate them all without judging the food's quality. However, Buhara happily replies that his stomach was really empty, adding that they were still able to reduce the number of examinees. Mechi stresses to him that Gourmet Hunters should have extraordinary taste buds, proceeding to strike the gong again and announcing that 70 examinees have passed the roast pig round. Still crouching high up in a nearby tree, Satotz is impressed that 70 were able to pass since a strike to a Great Stamp's forehead requires precision, bravery, quick-thinking, and athleticism. However, he realizes that Menchi's test will be even more difficult since she is tough to please. It's then stated that as a Gourmet Hunter, Menchi is one of the world's most prominent chefs and demands the most from every dish she tastes. It's added that her contributions to the culinary world have earned her the title of Single-Star Hunter (which requires notable achievements in a single field) at the age of 21. Menchi warns the examinees that she will be a harsh judge compared to Buhara and announces that her dish for part two of the Second Phase will be sushi. Nearly all the examinees have no clue what sushi is and anxiously wonder how they're supposed to make it. Menchi chuckles at their confusion and explains that the dish comes from a small island country. She then reveals elaborate sushi stations for every examinee, explaining that they have all the tools they need and that the key ingredient—rice—has already been cooked for them. She adds that she prefers, which is hand-pressed, and reminds them that the test will be over once her appetite has been satiated. The confused examinees look over the various tools, and Gon wonders if they need to make rice balls, but Killua holds up a knife and guesses that there's more to it. As the others try to figure it out, Hanzo chuckles to himself and proudly says that it's his country Menchi mentioned. However, he quickly realizes that he can't appear too happy and that he has to seem like he's also struggling. As he sees another examinee trying to mold the rice with his hands, Hanzo tries to contain his laughter, but several of the examinees immediately realize that he knows how to make it. Leorio tries to work out the details, and Kurapika then says that he remembers reading about the dish, believing that it involves rice mixed with vinegar and is combined with raw fish. As Leorio wonders aloud how they will find fish in a forest, Kurapika throws one of the tools at him and tells him to be quiet, pointing out that forests have sources of water. The other examinees overhear Leorio's mention of fish and immediately run toward the forest, with Leorio upset that they overheard them and Kurapika angry that he was so loud. After using various means to catch fish in the nearby rivers and ponds, the examinees return to their stations and wonder how to prepare it. Buhara chuckles and tells Menchi that she's mean since the examinees are stuck with freshwater fish when proper sushi requires fish from the sea. Menchi happily replies that it will make the test interesting and that she's eager to see their creations, adding that she is more of a chef than an examiner. Buhara is left unsure about Menchi's decision and worries that it may not turn out well. Leorio uses the ingredients that Kurapika remembered and confidently presents his dish as the "Leorio Special", opening the lid to reveal a big ball of rice with multiple living fish sticking out of it. Menchi immediately tosses the plate over her head and stresses that the shape is essential to "nigiri sushi". Gon then presents his dish, a live fish with rice covering the center, and Menchi tosses it away as well. Three other examinees fail to get it right, and Menchi angrily asks if they plan to starve her, wondering to herself how they can't figure it out after all the hints she has given. Kurapika begins to analyze Menchi’s statement about the shape and making as many as they like, deducing that it involves the two sticks being used as utensils and the small dish of condiment. Kurapika guesses that a single sushi can only be so big and presents his dish, which looks very similar to Gon's, and Menchi tosses it away as well, angrily calling the examinees hopeless and saying that they have no skills or style. A chuckling Hanzo approaches her and reveals his dish, whose appearance Menchi approves. However, when she takes a bite of it, she tells Hanzo that it's no good, leaving him enraged as he explains that sushi is just rice formed into a bite-sized shape and then wasabi and fish are added. Hanzo realizes that he just said the explanation in front of the other examinees, who realize how simple it is. However, Menchi angrily replies that it takes 10 years of training to start making proper sushi, grabbing Hanzo by the collar and telling him that he doesn't have what it takes. Buhara realizes that Menchi has reached the point where she loses all perspective, adding that only a few chefs in the world can meet her standards. Menchi states that she is even hungrier after all the yelling, and the other examinees eagerly present their dishes. Menchi realizes that she will have to test by taste now that they all know what to do, but she continues to reject their dishes. Buhara tells her that she is being too picky, but Menchi remains stubborn and points out the smallest details that are wrong. She then takes a sip from her drink and suddenly says that she's full, with the examinees realizing that she didn't pass a single one of them.

Chapter 110 September 4th: Part 9 (94⑨, "Kugatsu Yokka (Kyū)") is the 110th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As the six Phantom Troupe members leave their hideout, Nobunaga asks if the Nostrade Family members were staying at the Hotel Beitacle, but Machi tells him that Shalnark said they checked out yesterday. Chrollo guesses that they moved to another room using a different name. Hearing the group's footsteps in the distance, Melody is unable to make out their words in the rain and tells Killua that she can hear five or six sets of footsteps, also able to tell that they are moving in the opposite direction. Killua is impressed by Melody and says that he thought Gon had good hearing, with Melody telling him that it's her ability. The two move down from the rooftop and run to follow the Troupe. Melody says that since Kurapika always does things by himself, he must be really desperate to ask them for help. She suddenly asks if Killua is an assassin, and Killua replies that he used to be, asking how she could tell. Melody says that his footsteps are barely audible even though he's right next to her. Killua replies that he's just used to walking quietly, and Melody adds that they are the quietest she knows, understanding why Kurapika would ask for his help. As Killua says that he doesn't really want to help, Melody suddenly stops him and tells him to turn at a crowded intersection, revealing that the Troupe is around 100 yards down the street. Killua asks if she can tell where they are among the crowd of people, and Melody replies that everyone has a unique sound. Killua internally describes her as a machine and adds that he won't need to use Zetsu if they can keep their distance. He begins to climb up to another rooftop and tells Melody to wait there, saying that he will check if the woman they want is among the group. It's stated that Neon is a Specialist whose ability allows her to predict the future through poems that she unconsciously writes down. It's added that the target's name (aliases are allowed), full birth date, and blood type must be written on the same paper on which she writes the fortune, with an image of the target also needed if they are not present. It's then explained that ominous fortunes will always contain advice and that any misfortune can be avoided if the warnings are followed. It's finally stated that Neon is unable to tell her own fortune. Killua calls Gon and tells him that he found Pakunoda, adding that there are six members in total and that Nobunaga is also with them. He reveals that there is someone there who wasn't at the hideout earlier, guessing that he's their leader. Gon asks about his appearance, and looking through binoculars, Killua tells him that he's wearing a black coat with a reverse cross on the back. He adds that while he has black hair, he can't see his face since he doesn't want to risk looking at them from the front. As Killua praises the group's vigilance, Kurapika asks Gon for the phone and then asks Killua about the Troupe's current location. Killua replies that they are heading west near the Motoba Building on Continental Street. Looking at a map of the city, Kurapika points out that there's a train station nearby and asks if Killua can board the same train. Killua says that he can if it's crowded enough, and Kurapika tells Leorio to head south. After some time passes, Killua says that he is in the last car while Melody is in the car with the Troupe members. Gon says that the group had a car when they caught them, but Leorio points out that there's too much traffic downtown. Still looking at the map, Kurapika notes that the Castor Line goes downtown where both the auctions and the Hotel Beitacle are located. As Melody continues to follow the Troupe, Killua tells Kurapika that they got off the train and are at Lipa Station, with the Troupe making their way toward the Saloma Mall exit. After realizing that it's near the hotel, Kurapika calls Squala and warns him that the Troupe found out that they changed rooms. Squala quickly decides to leave and makes sure to bring the (fake) Scarlet Eyes with him after abandoning the rest of the luggage. Leorio, Kurapika, and Gon park outside the station to wait for the Troupe to arrive. Kurapika says that they shouldn't get any closer since the group may detect his bloodlust. He tells Gon that his attack should only take half a second and that they will still be able to dodge it unless Gon provides a distraction. As Kurapika spots the Troupe members leaving the station (with Shizuku wondering where the hotel is), Squala is seen making his escape and carrying the Scarlet Eyes.

Chapter 111 September 4th: Part 10 (94⑩, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū)") is the 111th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Kortopi tells the other Phantom Troupe members that the copied Scarlet Eyes are slowly moving down. Chrollo says that they must be inside an elevator, guessing that the Nostrade Family members are leaving. Nobunaga thinks that they should hurry, and as a nervous Squala is seen inside an elevator at the Hotel Beitacle, Chrollo tells the others to stay close and that they will capture them together. He then tells Pakunoda that she will ask them about Uvogin and that Nobunaga is free to deal with them afterward. An overview map of the city is shown with the locations of various individuals as the Spiders begin to sprint through the rain toward the hotel. Kurapika sees them heading in that direction, and Leorio worries that they will be faster than a car since it's almost rush hour. Kurapika suddenly exits the car and tells Leorio to wait there until he calls him. Gon runs after him and says that he has an idea. Killua tells Kurapika by phone that they are outside and that Melody said the Troupe is heading northwest. Kurapika reveals that he is already chasing after them, and Killua worries that it's a bad idea to follow them on foot since they will sense him, but Kurapika hangs up before Killua can say anything else. The Troupe members run along the walls and startle the people walking with umbrellas, with one saying that they must have been ninjas. Kortopi reveals that the copied eyes are now moving at 25 mph toward two o'clock, and Chrollo guesses that the people got into a car. Squala is seen driving with his dogs in the car and telling them that while he planned to wait until he found another job, it's his last day working for the Nostrade Family. Killua calls Leorio and wonders where Gon is. Leorio replies that he ran after Kurapika, telling Killua that he is struggling to make it to the hotel through all the traffic. Killua says that they will have to follow Kurapika too, upset that he abandoned their plan. Chrollo suddenly tells the others that they are being followed, surprising Machi and Shizuku and causing Nobunaga to quickly remove the covering from his katana and wonder where the chain user is. Chrollo orders Nobunaga, Pakunoda, and Kortopi to keep moving toward the hotel before he, Machi, and Shizuku (now holding Blinky) suddenly turn around and stop in place, forcing Kurapika and Gon to dart behind cover. Chrollo asks Shizuku and Machi if they saw them as he slowly walks in their direction. Shizuku answers that one is behind the trash can and Machi adds that one is in the alley. After Chrollo tells them to keep watching that direction and the two begin to use Gyo around their eyes, Kurapika readies his chains and prepares for a fight. Gon knows that Kurapika has no chance against three Troupe members and decides to reveal himself, apologizing and promising to stop chasing after them. Shizuku is left confused, but Machi recognizes Gon from their earlier encounter. Chrollo asks if he's the kid that Nobunaga wanted him to meet, and Machi adds that there's one more, telling him to show himself. After Killua nonchalantly steps out, Machi wonders what they want since the Mafia's reward was canceled. Killua feigns shock and Gon waits nervously in silence. Machi remains skeptical and asks what they should do with them. After telling her to seize them, Chrollo then calls Phinks and tells them to come to the hotel. After binding their hands with her thread, Machi asks if they should get rid of them right there, but Chrollo trusts her earlier hunch about their possible connection to the chain user Gon then asks Chrollo how he can kill people who have nothing to do with them, causing Chrollo to look at him with a serious expression and chuckle at his bloodlust even after surrendering. He is unsure at first, but then says that he may only be able to do so because they have nothing to do with him. He adds that he doesn't like to discuss his motives, but reveals that the reason may be the key to understanding himself. As Gon stands in silence and Killua is left confused by his words, Chrollo says that they will head to the hotel and wait for the others, telling Machi and Shizuku to kill the two boys if they try to escape. Kurapika and Melody follow the Troupe at a distance, with Melody stressing that they can only get so close now that the Troupe has their guard up (also telling Kurapika to use Zetsu). Kurapika is left feeling angry and helpless, but Melody tells him to stay patient and stresses that Gon and Killua let themselves be caught because no one will be able to stop the Troupe if they capture him. Kurapika calms down and apologizes, but Melody assures him that they just need to wait and asks about Squala. Kurapika guesses that he left his phone at the hotel since he isn't answering. Squala is seen stuck in traffic as Nobunaga, Pakunoda, and Kortopi stand around his car. While Pakunoda says that he isn't the chain user, Nobunaga points out that he was on the list, telling him to get out of the car. As he exits the car and lets his dogs leave behind him, Squala says to himself that he has experienced his share of carnage and gained a six sense which is telling him that it's his day to die.

Chapter 112 September 4th: Part 11 (94⑪, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Ichi)") is the 112th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As Pakunoda holds Squala at gunpoint and restrains his hands, Nobunaga warns that he will kill him if he even moves. Pakunoda then says that she will ask him some questions and tells him to answer truthfully. It's stated that Squala is a Manipulator whose ability involves him taking care of his dogs in exchange for their services (such as protection, running errands, and spy missions). It's added that they can have complex conversations using their barks like . Pakunoda says that one of his colleagues uses chains and asks where he is. Squala is left confused and asks who they are, but when he tries to add that Nostrade is his boss, Pakunoda breaks his right arm and tells him to answer the question or she will break his left as well. Nobunaga reminds him that he warned him not to move and that he just needs to answer her questions. Pakunoda then asks what they did with Uvogin, reminding him that it was the large man they kidnapped. As sweat drips down his face, an upset Squala answers that he last saw Uvogin before he escaped. Pakunoda asks where his other colleagues are, and Squala says that they have already left, adding that he was also heading home. Pakunoda tells him that he shouldn't lie, but Squala angrily replies that it's the truth and asks her why he would. Pakunoda again asks about the man with chains, but Squala stresses that he doesn't know anyone with that description. Pakunoda finally asks if he loves anyone, and Squala defiantly answers that he wouldn't be working with the Mafia if he did. However, Pakunoda smirks and asks if her name is Eliza, calling her pretty as Squala is left stunned. But before Squala can finish warning the Phantom Troupe members not to harm Eliza, Nobunaga decapitates him with his katana and says that he told him twice not to move. Nobunaga asks if she got the information, which Pakunoda confirms as the bystanders in their cars begin to panic after seeing Squala's death. She says that it will take too long to tell him about it and that she will just shoot Squala's memories into them, revealing her Memory Bomb ability. She asks if he's scared, but Nobunaga calmly tells her to do it and notes that they are old friends. After Pakunoda shoots both Nobunaga and Kortopi in the head, two bystanders are left stunned that the criminals are now shooting each other. Kurapika's appearance and voice suddenly enter Nobunaga's mind, and he vows to remember his name and face until he kills him. More bystanders are shocked to see that the two people are still alive even after being shot, wondering if it was a movie stunt. As the three Troupe members flee the scene, Pakunoda calls Chrollo and tells him that while Squala didn't know anything about Uvogin or the chain user's ability, they now know his name and appearance. After Chrollo tells her that they will be waiting in the lobby of the Hotel Beitacle, he informs Machi and Shizuku of the new development. A frustrated Gon says to himself that while he told Kurapika about carrying out the plan in a hotel lobby, they didn't decide on the time and he doesn't know where they're going. As Gon tries to figure out a way to let Kurapika know, Killua says to himself that Melody would have heard Chrollo's phone call, and Kurapika would know where they're going. He thinks that he has the perfect plan to blind the Troupe, but worries about the others figuring it out and not knowing when to execute it. He stresses that they need to be in complete synchronization and that he needs to find a way to communicate a time to them. The two boys and the three Troupe members arrive at the hotel and wait in the lobby. Killua says to himself that the Troupe will be suspicious of anyone that enters the hotel now, hoping that the others are already inside. He then whispers to Melody to give them a signal, repeating it twice as Gon continues to think of what to do. Killua says that it's their only chance, but before he can whisper it to Melody, Leorio suddenly slams down a newspaper and yells at someone on the phone, making sure that they know the hotel's name is Beitacle. He sees them staring at him and asks if they want a piece of him. Shizuku whispers if they should deal with him, but Chrollo tells them to ignore him. Leorio tells the rest of the people in the lobby to mind their own business, returning to his phone conversation and using the phrase "close his eyes" before referencing seven o'clock and one second late. After Leorio hangs up, Gon gives a slight smirk and says to himself that Kurapika knows, confident that they will be able to use the cover of darkness. Killua tells himself that he will dislocate his joints and free himself from Machi's restraints, adding that he can attack within 0.7 seconds. He is confident that the plan will work since the Troupe will need a few seconds to adjust to the darkness once the power goes out. As the announcer on Leorio's radio begins a song request, Gon and Killua see that there are five minutes left until seven o'clock.

Chapter 113 September 4th: Part 12 (94⑫, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Ni)") is the 113th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As the storm rages on outside the Hotel Beitacle, Gon and Killua note that there are three minutes left until they carry out their plan. After Shizuku spots Nobunaga, Pakunoda, and Kortopi entering the hotel, Nobunaga is ecstatic to see the two boys again and coyly suggests that they changed their mind about joining the Phantom Troupe. Killua tells him that they didn't know their bounties had been canceled, and Nobunaga criticizes their tailing skills, adding that it must be fate that they're meeting again. Killua checks the clock and sees that there are two minutes left. Nobunaga asks the two to be his friends, but Killua refuses and repeats that they were only following them because of the reward, closing his eyes and saying that they don't even want to look at their faces. Gon realizes what Killua is doing and closes his eyes as well. Nobunaga likens their attitude to Uvogin's and asks Chrollo what he thinks of them, but Machi says that they are fearless only because they're kids, asking Nobunaga what the chain user is like. However, Chrollo asks Pakunoda to first check the boys again, telling her to ask what they are hiding. Killua realizes that the question will allow Pakunoda to read many of their memories at once, worried that they won't be able to carry out their plan in time. The announcer on Leorio's radio says that they are down to their last minute, and Killua tries his best to stall Pakunoda by saying that it would be pointless to read them since they have nothing to hide. However, Pakunoda grabs Killua's face and tells him to be quiet, with Gon adding that they will stop them even if they do find out what they're hiding. Pakunoda grabs Gon's face as well and says that they misunderstand her ability, explaining that she extracts the memories from beneath their consciousness. She adds that her questions cause the original memories to float up to the surface and that they cannot be falsified. The time reaches 7 o'clock and Pakunoda asks what the two boys are hiding, but the moment she reads their memories, the power suddenly goes out and shrouds the hotel lobby in darkness. With his eyes already adjusted to the darkness, Killua finishes dislocating his wrists to free himself from Machi's restraints, quickly breaking Pakunoda's left arm. But before she can react, Gon kicks her in the chin and Machi realizes that Killua freed himself. As Machi understands what they were plotting, Killua suddenly kicks her in the side and forces her away from Gon. However, Machi refuses to let Gon get away and pulls back on the thread, sending Gon flying back from Killua. Killua realizes that he will have to kill Machi to sever her thread. He forces his hand into her chest toward her heart, but Machi traps it with her muscles and pulls him in tight, saying that the darkness couldn't hide his bloodlust and that he should aim for the neck. Gon realizes that Killua has been caught, but when he tries to help him, Nobunaga uses his En and grabs Gon by the ankle, saying that he can tell where he is even in the darkness. As Nobunaga holds Gon upside down and praises the boys' idea, a knife suddenly flies toward him and sticks in the wall behind him. He says that it came from the door and must have been a final shot. Shizuku realizes that the man with the radio was also involved and guesses that he already left. Nobunaga adds that he probably threw the knife and says that they just need the two boys, assuring the others that their eyes will soon adjust. However, before Shizuku can finish her next sentence, she suddenly realizes that Chrollo is missing.

Chapter 114 September 4th: Part 13 (94⑬, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū San)") is the 114th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. With Gon and Killua restrained, the Phantom Troupe members suddenly realize that Chrollo is missing. Looking again at the knife stuck in the wall, Nobunaga asks Shizuku to hold Gon while Machi checks on Pakunoda, who replies that she’s fine besides a broken left arm and molar. Machi says that she has a few broken ribs, stressing that they underestimated the two boys as she continues to restrain Killua. Pakunoda prepares to tell the others about Gon and Killua's memories, but after removing the note from the knife and reading it, Nobunaga hands it to Pakunoda and says that it's for her. Pakunoda reads the note which says that Chrollo will die if she speaks of the boys' memories. She then uses her ability on the note and sees Kurapika writing the note and holding a chained Chrollo. The man who was talking to Kurapika wonders what's going on and asks when the power is coming back. Pakunoda realizes that Kurapika was pretending to be the receptionist, who was the one person they weren't watching. She says that Chrollo could have easily dodged the chains in the time it would have taken them to reach him, but the power going out delayed his reaction time by just enough. She realizes that the two boys knew about the plan, but that it wasn't completely arranged ahead of time since they only decided to go to the Hotel Beitacle recently. She then asks herself why she couldn't tell that the two knew about the chain user the first time she checked them when they both know about him now. She deduces that Kurapika was hiding his ability even from his friends, adding that he must be intelligent and cold-blooded. She understands that the threat to kill Chrollo isn't a bluff and that his colleague named Melody will be able to tell if she reveals the secret to the other Troupe members. She realizes that Kurapika is willing to let his own friends die, but also recognizes that they are valuable as hostages and can be used to get Chrollo back. As Pakunoda remains deep in thought, Nobunaga snaps her out of it by repeating her name. He tells her not to say anything and takes Killua from Machi so that she can focus on her threads. He is confident that the perpetrators will contact them after leaving a message and two hostages behind. With Gon and Killua both telling themselves that Kurapika successfully carried out the plan, Nobunaga stresses that they should prioritize keeping the two boys as hostages, adding that they need to wait for the other Troupe members to show up. Pakunoda then has a flashback to when the Troupe was formed in Meteor City. Chrollo tells the six other members that he is the head and they are the legs. He adds that while the legs do what the head says, sometimes they will be more important than him, stressing that someone else will take over if he dies. As Machi whispers to Pakunoda to ask if it’s Chrollo, he continues by saying that while his orders are most important, his life isn't. He finally tells them never to forget that the Spider as a whole needs to survive, not just one individual. Back in the present, Pakunoda asks herself about the current situation and says that they could easily defeat the chain user if she just told them about his ability and weakness. However, she worries about Chrollo dying for them and says that it will be just like what happened to Uvogin. As she wonders what Chrollo's fortune said, she suddenly remembers her own fortune which mentioned betrayal and the reaper waiting in a cramped room. She wonders if the betrayal refers to talking or staying quiet, also guessing that the boys are the reaper. She remembers Chrollo's words about the survival of the whole and wonders if the cramped room refers to her own mind. She then remembers that since it's still Saturday, that part of the poem won't come into play until the following week. As Pakunoda wonders which choice she should make and asks herself what Chrollo would do, Machi snaps her out of it and tells her just to stay quiet and not think about it. After the hotel's power comes back on, Nobunaga calls Phinks and the others to tell them to hurry since Chrollo has been taken. Pakunoda knows that Machi is right and tells herself that they need him back even if it means betraying the Spiders. Elsewhere in the city, Chrollo sits chained in the back seat next to Kurapika. With Melody in the passenger seat, Leorio checks his rearview mirror, but Kurapika assures him that they won't be able to give chase until the other Troupe members join them, since some of them were injured. Chrollo eyes Kurapika, who sternly asks what he's looking at. Chrollo replies that he didn't expect the chain user to be a woman, but Kurapika removes his wig and warns him to watch what he says. Chrollo tells Kurapika that he won't kill him since he left his friends behind, but Kurapika says that he isn't in the mood for his threats. As Leorio tries to calm Kurapika down, Chrollo adds that the event wasn't even mentioned in his fortune, which means that it's completely insignificant. With his eyes widening in anger, Kurapika calls him coward as Melody tries to get his attention and Leorio threatens to kill him if he kills Chrollo.

Chapter 115 September 4th: Part 14 (94⑭, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Yon)") is the 115th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. After Phinks, Shalnark, and Feitan arrive at the Hotel Beitacle, the other Phantom Troupe members tell them that Chrollo was kidnapped during a blackout, with Kortopi handing them the message from the chain user. Feitan wonders why they didn't chase after them, but Nobunaga explains that Machi and Pakunoda were injured during the incident, adding that the chain user has professional Hunters with him and that the two boys are on par with them. Feitan still wonders why they didn't give chase, and Nobunaga tells him to reread the message, stressing that Chrollo can't escape by himself since he's probably being restrained by the same chains that were used on Uvogin. Phinks is left confused by his assumption that Chrollo was chained, and Nobunaga angrily repeats that there was a blackout and that the chain user was gone once they could see again. He stresses that they need to keep the two boys as hostages, and Shalnark gets everyone's attention by saying that they need to stay together as a group and treat Machi and Pakunoda's injuries while they go after Chrollo. As Shalnark begins to talk about what they will do if they find their car, Phinks' phone suddenly rings. Elsewhere in the city, Milluki is seen at a restaurant wondering what he should have for dinner. Kurapika says that he will give him three instructions, and even though Phinks immediately asks if he's the chain user, Kurapika says that he will obey them or his leader will die. His three orders are to not come after them or harm the hostages, and to put Pakunoda on the phone. Phinks asks about the second order and tells Kurapika that the hostages broke some bones before they arrived, chuckling as he gives a sly smile toward the other Troupe members. Kurapika says that the negotiations are off and immediately hangs up. Phinks quickly calls back and apologizes for lying about the hostages being injured. Kurapika says that it's his only warning and again tells him to give the phone to Pakunoda. After he does so, both Pakunoda and Nobunaga hit him on the head. Nobunaga reminds him that Chrollo's life is on the line, and Phinks says that he was just trying to help. After Pakunoda answers, Kurapika says that she will be the only one to hear the call, telling her to step away from the others. Kurapika then asks her if she has met Squala and confirms that she knows about Melody, who can tell if she lies at all. He forbids Pakunoda from having any further contact with the other Troupe members (including gesturing or even eye contact). He tells her to come alone to a location that he will specify and that he will kill Chrollo if there's any change in her pulse. Kurapika then tells her to give the phone to someone besides the person who initially answered. Pakunoda hands it to Nobunaga, and Kurapika explains that while Pakunoda will leave by herself, the rest of the Troupe must stay back at their hideout. He tells him to give the phone to Pakunoda and to get another cell phone for when they call back. He warns that Chrollo will die if any of them are missing from the hideout, and Nobunaga understands his instructions, giving the phone back to Pakunoda. Kurapika tells her to be at Lingon Airport by eight o'clock. Pakunoda immediately begins to leave the hotel without saying anything or even looking at the other members. Nobunaga tells them that she has to go alone while they return to the hideout. Phinks, however, doesn't care about the chain user's order to not come after him, and Nobunaga angrily grabs him by the collar and reminds him that Chrollo's life is at stake. Phinks calls him an idiot and calmly points out that they will then kill the chain user to put an end to it all. With Nobunaga left stunned, Feitan reminds him that Chrollo would agree that the Spiders should be the priority, adding that his mindset is an insult to the group. Phinks says that he isn't joking about following Pakunoda, and Shalnark agrees that they shouldn't obey the chain user's orders since their fortunes will end up coming true. Machi and Kortopi agree with Nobunaga about obeying the chain user's orders for the time being, but Phinks asks them if they should wait until half of them are dead before doing anything. He then asks Shizuku what she thinks, and she asks if they should flip a coin, but he replies that the discussion is beyond their mission now. She decides to agree with Nobunaga and says that she doesn't want Chrollo or Pakunoda to die yet, pointing out that Pakunoda felt the same way since she left without saying anything. Phinks lets out a big sigh and says that he can't get through to him, suddenly becoming serious and saying that he would like to kill them if they didn't have to follow Pakunoda. However, as Phinks begins to leave, Nobunaga readies his katana and warns him not to move another step. Phinks readies his aura in response and asks him to try it, but Shizuku hits Nobunaga on the back of the head with Blinky and knocks him unconscious. Phinks wonders why she did that if she agreed with him, but Shizuku replies that while she does in her heart, the rules are absolute, reminding them that there's no fighting within the Troupe and that breaking the rules is the same as rejecting the Spiders and Chrollo. Shalnark's phone suddenly rings, but before Phinks can even say hello, Kurapika orders him to give the phone to the hostages. Killua says that they are okay for now and that the Troupe members were arguing about whether they should follow Pakunoda. Phinks quickly takes the phone back, and Kurapika reveals to him that Pakunoda only followed his instructions because they have someone who can tell if any of them are lying. He again warns them that Chrollo's life is on the line and tells them to be at their hideout in thirty minutes. After Kurapika hangs up, a frustrated Phinks realizes that they have no choice but to follow his orders. At the Troupe's hideout, Franklin tells Bonolenov that the others are coming back since all of them need to be there or Chrollo will die. He calls the chain user intelligent for using the hostages to receive updates, and Bonolenov adds that he's tough as well. Hisoka is seen checking his phone and says to himself that while it's his only chance to fight him, Chrollo will die if he leaves. He wonders what he should do and decides to text Illumi for help. Standing on a rooftop elsewhere, Illumi agrees to help since he has known him a little longer than Chrollo, adding that it will cost him.

Chapter 116 September 4th: Part 15 (94⑮, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Go)") is the 116th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Kurapika's eyes turn scarlet as he continues to angrily stare at the chained Chrollo, who asks if he needs to repeat himself, adding that the situation is no different from a coffee break. Kurapika suddenly punches him in the face, but when Chrollo gives a sly smirk and chuckles in reply, Kurapika begins to punch him repeatedly before Leorio puts his hand on his shoulder and calms him down. He tells Kurapika that it isn't his style and says to himself that he doesn't blame him for losing his temper against the man who was responsible for the death of his clan. Although Leorio tells himself that he has to stop him and says aloud that they don't have the advantage yet, Chrollo reveals that all their assumptions are flawed since he is worthless as a hostage. Kurapika threatens to gag him again if he keeps lying, but Melody reveals that he's telling the truth, with Chrollo warning Kurapika that he's the one who's cornered. Kurapika asks Melody what she means, and she replies that Chrollo's heartbeat shows no changes and that he not only doesn't fear death but accepts it, enjoying the fact that it's always near him. She becomes frightened by the sound and covers her ears, yelling that she doesn't want to hear his or Kurapika's heartbeat any longer. Melody finally adds that while Chrollo is the Phantom Troupe's leader, he also believes that he's worthless as a hostage. Kurapika asks him who he is, and Chrollo simply replies that they are the Spiders. Kurapika then asks him if he was the group's leader five years ago when they massacred the Kurta Clan for their Scarlet Eyes. After Chrollo stays silent, Kurapika readies his Judgment Chain and orders him to answer. Chrollo asks if it's the same one he used to kill Uvogin and wonders what his comrade said before he died. Kurapika replies that he doesn't remember and again orders Chrollo to answer his question. Chrollo coyly asks Melody if Kurapika is lying and tells him that just like Uvogin, he has nothing to say to him. Leorio assures Kurapika that Chrollo is just baiting him, and Kurapika grits his teeth in anger, wondering why his plan is falling apart and why he has to allow him to live. However, Kurapika tells himself that he can't kill him and puts away his chain, turning away from Chrollo and pulling out his phone. Chrollo realizes that Kurapika has a weakness that the rest of the Troupe can exploit, hoping that Pakunoda brings the others with her to the meeting. As Kurapika calls Pakunoda and tells her to come to Lingon Airport, Chrollo says to himself that Kurapika will prioritize his friends over his mission. At the Troupe's hideout, Franklin and Bonolenov suddenly hear a noise somewhere in the building, with Hisoka saying that they should check it out. He leads the way and goes off by himself into another room, with Franklin telling him to be careful. The other two Spiders suddenly hear another noise and spot Kalluto crouching near a large window. He quickly leaps down and draws their attention as they watch him make his escape. Bonolenov wonders if they should follow, but Franklin worries that it could be a trap and decides to wait until the other members return. Hisoka regroups with the other two, but his eyes are now pitch-black as he gives a small grin.

Chapter 117 September 4th: Part 16 (94⑯, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Roku)") is the 117th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. After arriving at Lingon Airport, Pakunoda is contacted by Kurapika and told to board a nearby airship. Once the ship is in the air, Kurapika, the chained Chrollo, and Melody meet her near the door. Melody confirms that Pakunoda is telling the truth when she assures Kurapika of her identity, and Kurapika agrees to release Chrollo if she agrees to two conditions for each of them. As Kurapika readies his Judgment Chain, Chrollo hopes that Pakunoda can discover that Kurapika has a weakness. Kurapika first says that he forbids all use of Nen for Chrollo, but before he can say aloud that he forbids all contact with the other Phantom Troupe members, he remembers Chrollo's words about being worthless as a hostage. He realizes that the Spiders will continue to exist even if he eliminates their leader and that they would be willing to sacrifice him for the sake of the whole group. Kurapika remains conflicted about what to do, but decides that his top priority should be getting Gon and Killua back. He then pictures a young boy from the Kurta Clan and says that he never wants to lose anyone again. Kurapika tells Pakunoda that Chrollo can also no longer contact any of the other Troupe members, explaining that he will stab him with his Judgment Chain and asking if she finds the conditions acceptable. After Pakunoda agrees to the two conditions, Kurapika stabs Chrollo with his Judgment Chain and wraps it around his heart. He moves on to Pakunoda, telling her that she will first free Gon and Killua without any tricks by midnight (with the details to be explained later). He then sets the condition that she will not reveal anything about him, asking her if she objects to either of the conditions. After Pakunoda agrees to them, Kurapika stabs her with his Judgment Chain and whispers to Melody if she could tell whether Gon and Killua were being manipulated by reading their heartbeats. Melody confirms that while she hasn't heard Gon's, she could tell if Killua's were different since she has heard it before. Melody worries about Kurapika and tells herself that he refuses to acknowledge the conflict within himself. She adds that if the Spiders were actually heartless, Pakunoda would not have come alone and the hostage exchange wouldn't be a viable option. She recognizes that she's unaware of all the Troupe's wicked acts, but says to herself that Pakunoda also just wants to save her friend. She hopes that Kurapika realizes that while Chrollo is remaining resolute concerning the Troupe's rules, Pakunoda is willing to go against them to save someone she cares about. Kurapika then tells Pakunoda that she will return to their hideout and inform the others of the exchange, adding that she should return to the airport with only the hostages by midnight. He stresses that she must come alone and not tell the others where she is going. Pakunoda agrees to the exchange and asks to be taken back to the airport. Kurapika wonders why she isn't asking any questions or raising any objections to the deal if she knows who he is. However, Pakunoda simply replies that Kurapika wouldn't be asking that if he planned to trick her, telling him to hurry since she doesn't want to waste any time. Pakunoda returns to the Troupe's hideout and tells the others about the exchange as Gon and Killua sit chained on the floor and Nobunaga lies still unconscious. With his aura swelling around him, Phinks tells her to reveal the location and adds that they will kill the two boys as well as the chain user. Pakunoda remains silent as Machi asks him if it's the right course of action.

Chapter 118 September 4th: Part 17 (94⑰, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Nana)") is the 118th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. Phinks refuses to yield and again tells Pakunoda to say where the chain user and Chrollo are, threatening to stop her if she tries to leave. Pakunoda refuses to reveal their location and says that she is taking the two boys with her to the hostage exchange. Phinks angrily wonders whose side she's on, but Machi tells her to leave while she keeps them busy. Feitan scoffs at her comment as they all ready their auras for combat. Phinks wonders what's wrong with them and asks if they are still sane, with Feitan guessing that the chain user was able to manipulate them during the encounter at the hotel. After Feitan claims that he will force Pakunoda to talk, the chained and frustrated Gon asks Phinks and Feitan if they can’t understand why Pakunoda is cooperating with the exchange and why Machi is trying to help her. He angrily shouts that they're trying to save their leader and that they just want their friend back. Phinks tells him to be quiet and says that he just wants to be saved, but Gon suddenly breaks the chains restraining him. As Killua breaks his restraints as well, Gon denies Phinks' claim and tells him to take it back. Phinks signals to the angry Feitan that he will take care of things, warning Gon that he will snap his neck if he moves one step. Gon sticks out his tongue and says that he won't then since he isn't dumb. He stresses that unlike them, Kurapika would stay calm and keep any promises he made. He adds that Pakunoda trusts him because she met him, assuring Phinks that his leader will be returned if he just does what she says. A frustrated Phinks again tells him to be quiet, but Franklin speaks up and says that he should let Pakunoda leave. While Phinks can't believe that he is taking their side, Franklin turns to Shalnark and asks him what the worst-case scenario would be. Shalnark answers if Chrollo were already dead and Hisoka, Pakunoda, Machi, Kortopi, Shizuku, and Nobunaga were being manipulated. He adds that they wouldn't learn the chain user's location and the two boys would also escape. However, Franklin bluntly tells him that he's wrong since the worst case would be all of them dying and the end of the Phantom Troupe. After the stunned Shalnark admits that he's right, Franklin continues by saying that they are relying too much on Chrollo and that their deaths would actually be the worst act of betrayal toward him. He tells them that they need to stop fighting and let Pakunoda leave with the two boys, adding that they will just kill the manipulated members and start over if Chrollo doesn't return. Machi says that they can believe what they want, but stresses that she isn't being manipulated and won't let them kill her. Kurapika calls Shalnark's phone again, but before Phinks can even say hello, he tells him to give the phone to the hostages. Phinks throws the phone to Gon, who assures Kurapika that he is fine and confirms that all the Troupe members are at the hideout. Gon throws the phone back and makes Shalnark anxious about it being broken. Phinks reluctantly tells Kurapika that they agree to his terms and that Pakunoda and the hostages are leaving now. As Pakunoda, Gon, and Killua walk out into the rain, Franklin wonders why Phinks isn't going after them since the chain user can't monitor the rest of them now. Phinks tells him to be quiet and says that they would only stop him if he tried, agreeing to wait and see what happens. He tells Franklin that he will also be dead if Chrollo doesn't return, and Franklin gives a smile of relief. After the three arrive at Lingon Airport, Kurapika tells them to board the nearby airship and assures them that the pilot knows the location. As he, Leorio, and Melody watch them from an airship already flying, Kurapika says that they can't be sure it's just the three of them until they board. Leorio suddenly spots someone in the distance as Kurapika's phone rings. Kurapika tells Melody to keep an eye out since he could be a decoy, but as soon as Leorio sees that it's Hisoka approaching them, Hisoka says hello to Kurapika and reveals that he left a double back at the hideout (where Illumi tells himself that his face will change back in four to five hours without his needles). Pakunoda is stunned to see Hisoka, who praises Kurapika's idea to use an airship since it will be difficult to follow to a remote location. Kurapika asks him what he wants, and Hisoka replies that he wants to be at the hostage exchange, coyly threatening to kill Gon and Killua if Kurapika refuses his request (though telling himself that he wouldn't get rid of them now). He reminds Kurapika that he only wants to fight Chrollo and promises to stay behind wherever he is released. Kurapika agrees to the deal, and the two airships make their way to a large rock formation. After the two groups exit their ships, Kurapika calls Killua and tells him to put the phone to his chest. After Melody confirms that he isn't being manipulated, Kurapika begins the hostage exchange. Chrollo walks over to Pakunoda and Hisoka, and the two boys make their way over to Kurapika, Leorio, and Melody. Killua breathes a sigh of relief, and the five of them board their airship to leave. Once in the air, Kurapika looks down on Chrollo and says that since he can no longer contact the other Troupe members or use Nen, he will experience having all his support taken away. As Chrollo looks up at Kurapika in return, Hisoka excitedly says that he has been anticipating the moment and asks Chrollo to fight him.

Chapter 119 September 4th: Part 18 (94⑱, "Kugatsu Yokka (Jū Hachi)") is the 119th chapter of the Hunter × Hunter manga, written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi. Synopsis. As Kurapika continues to look down on the two from his airship, Hisoka tells Chrollo that he only pretended to join the Phantom Troupe, suddenly revealing that he faked his Spider tattoo with Texture Surprise as he removes it and tosses it to the side. He assures Chrollo that he doesn't have to hold back since it isn't considered Troupe in-fighting. With Pakunoda watching them from inside the airship, Chrollo begins to chuckle and assures Hisoka that he wouldn't want to fight him anymore since Kurapika used his Judgment Chain on him and made him unable to use Nen. Left dumbfounded by the revelation, Hisoka returns to the airship with Pakunoda as the two leave Chrollo by himself on the large rock formation. Pakunoda asks him how he was able to sneak out of the hideout, and Hisoka replies that he has a friend good at disguising himself. As he texts Illumi to tell him that he can leave, he assures her that Chrollo is no longer in any danger from him since he isn't interested in broken toys. As the two airships head in different directions, Leorio is surprised that Hisoka left without fighting Chrollo, and Kurapika guesses that since Hisoka isn't actually a Troupe member, Chrollo told him about the Judgment Chain and that he couldn’t use Nen. With Leorio left stunned that Hisoka isn't a Spider, Gon and Killua join them as Kurapika quickly apologizes for putting their lives at risk. Gon says that it's fine and asks if he was able to use his chain on Chrollo. Although Kurapika confirms this, he adds that it isn't the end of everything. Pakunoda calls the Troupe and assures them that Chrollo has been released, promising to explain the details when she returns to the hideout.
